short_description.id: Skunk ape adalah makhluk mirip kera berbulu dan berbau busuk yang dilaporkan menghuni hutan dan rawa Florida, sering disebut sepupu Bigfoot.
short_description.en: The skunk ape is a hairy, foul-smelling ape-like creature reported to inhabit the forests and swamps of Florida, often called Bigfoot's cousin.

long_description.id: Skunk ape adalah makhluk mirip manusia mitos yang besar dan berbulu, dikatakan menghuni hutan dan rawa di Amerika Serikat bagian tenggara, terutama Florida. Ia sering dibandingkan dengan, disamakan dengan, atau disebut 'sepupu' Bigfoot, dan sering dianggap subtipe Bigfoot. Ia dilaporkan lebih kecil daripada Bigfoot dari Amerika Serikat utara dan Kanada.
long_description.en: The skunk ape is a big, hairy, mythical humanoid said to live in the forests and swamps of the southeastern United States, above all Florida. It is often compared with, equated to, or called the 'cousin' of Bigfoot, and is often considered a subtype of Bigfoot. It is reported to be smaller than Bigfoot of the northern United States and Canada.

long_description.id: Saksi menggambarkannya cukup konsisten: sosok berkaki dua setinggi sekitar 5–7 kaki yang menyerupai orangutan atau gorila, tertutup bulu lebat berwarna cokelat kemerahan sampai abu-abu atau hitam. Ciri universalnya adalah bau yang sangat kuat dan busuk, digambarkan seperti makanan busuk, daging membusuk, telur busuk, atau metana, dan namanya merujuk pada bau itu. Julukan lainnya termasuk Stink Ape, Swamp Monkey, dan Bardin Booger.
long_description.en: Witnesses describe it fairly consistently: a bipedal figure about 5–7 feet tall resembling an orangutan or gorilla, covered with shaggy brown, reddish, gray, or black fur. A universal feature is a very strong, foul odor described as like rotting food, decaying meat, rotten eggs, or methane, and its name refers to that odor. Other nicknames include Stink Ape, Swamp Monkey, and Bardin Booger.

long_description.id: Pada 1818, surat kabar lokal melaporkan 'monyet sebesar manusia' yang menjarah makanan dan menguntit nelayan di dekat Apalachicola. Pada 1942 seorang pria di Suwanee County melaporkan makhluk yang mencengkeram kendaraannya, dan pada 1971–1975 terjadi rentetan penampakan di Broward County dengan tuduhan menyerbu rumah dan membunuh ternak; pasukan pencari tidak menemukan jasad atau bukti. Pada 1977 diajukan RUU yang gagal disahkan untuk melarang mengganggu 'hewan antropoid atau mirip manusia'.
long_description.en: In 1818 local newspapers reported a 'man-sized monkey' raiding food stores and stalking fishermen near Apalachicola. In 1942 a man in Suwanee County reported a creature grabbing his vehicle, and in 1971–1975 a rash of sightings in Broward County brought claims of invading homes and killing livestock; posses found no body or evidence. In 1977 a bill that failed to pass was proposed to make it illegal to molest 'anthropoids or humanoid animals'.

long_description.id: Sebagian besar ilmuwan arus utama menolak keberadaannya dan menganggapnya hasil kombinasi cerita rakyat, salah identifikasi, dan tipuan. Tidak ada bukti pasti, fisik maupun genetik, yang pernah ditemukan; skeptis menyebut sebagian penampakan mungkin beruang hitam, dan Dinas Taman Nasional AS menganggapnya tipuan. Para kriptozoolog mengklaim kisah serupa pada budaya Seminole dan Miccosukee, tetapi klaim itu tak berdasar, dan arti istilah Shaawanoki diperdebatkan.
long_description.en: Most mainstream scientists reject its existence and consider it the result of a mix of folklore, misidentification, and hoax. No definitive physical or genetic evidence has ever been found; skeptics say some sightings may be black bears, and the US National Park Service considers it a hoax. Cryptozoologists claim similar stories in Seminole and Miccosukee culture, but the claims are unsubstantiated, and the meaning of the term Shaawanoki is disputed.

cultural_context.en: The skunk ape has become part of popular culture in the southern United States, particularly Florida, where it serves as an informal mascot of wilderness and rural life.

statement.en: In 1942, a man in Suwanee County reported a similar creature rushing out from the brush line while he drove down an isolated road; it was alleged to have grabbed onto his vehicle and beat on the running board and door for half a mile before departing.

claims.quote: From 1971 to 1975, a rash of sightings occurred in Broward County and surrounding areas. Multiple eyewitnesses reported nocturnal encounters with a 5 to 7 foot (1.5–2.1 meter) ape-like creature with dark red to black fur.

statement.id: Dari 1971 sampai 1975 terjadi rentetan penampakan di Broward County dan sekitarnya; banyak saksi melaporkan pertemuan malam hari dengan makhluk mirip kera setinggi 5–7 kaki (1,5–2,1 m) berbulu merah tua sampai hitam.
statement.en: From 1971 to 1975, a rash of sightings occurred in Broward County and surrounding areas; multiple eyewitnesses reported nocturnal encounters with a 5 to 7 foot (1.5–2.1 meter) ape-like creature with dark red to black fur.

claims.quote: Reports alleged that the skunk ape had invaded homes, stalked people, and killed several of a farmer's livestock including a horse and a bull. ... Posses were formed in an effort to locate the alleged creature, but no body or evidence was found.

statement.id: Laporan menuduh skunk ape menyerbu rumah, menguntit orang, dan membunuh beberapa ternak seorang petani termasuk kuda dan banteng; pasukan pencari dibentuk untuk menemukan makhluk itu, tetapi tak ditemukan jasad atau bukti.
statement.en: Reports alleged that the skunk ape had invaded homes, stalked people, and killed several of a farmer's livestock including a horse and a bull; posses were formed to locate the alleged creature, but no body or evidence was found.

claims.quote: In 1977, a failed-to-pass bill was proposed to the Florida state legislature to make it illegal to "take, possess, harm or molest anthropoids or humanoid animals".

statement.id: Pada 1977 diusulkan rancangan undang-undang ke legislatif Florida, yang gagal disahkan, untuk melarang 'mengambil, memiliki, mencederai, atau mengganggu antropoid atau hewan mirip manusia'.
statement.en: In 1977, a bill that failed to pass was proposed to the Florida state legislature to make it illegal to 'take, possess, harm or molest anthropoids or humanoid animals'.

claims.quote: Skeptical investigator Joe Nickell has written that some of the reports may represent sightings of the Florida black bear, possibly some suffering from mange, and it is likely that other sightings are hoaxes or general misidentification of wildlife. The United States National Park Service considers the skunk ape to be a hoax.

statement.id: Penyelidik skeptis Joe Nickell menulis bahwa sebagian laporan mungkin penampakan beruang hitam Florida, mungkin yang menderita kudis, dan bahwa penampakan lain kemungkinan tipuan atau salah identifikasi satwa; Dinas Taman Nasional AS menganggap skunk ape sebuah tipuan.
statement.en: Skeptical investigator Joe Nickell has written that some reports may be sightings of the Florida black bear, possibly some suffering from mange, and that other sightings are likely hoaxes or misidentification of wildlife; the United States National Park Service considers the skunk ape to be a hoax.

claims.quote: Cryptozoologists have made unsubstantiated claims that Seminole and Miccosukee culture includes stories of a foul-smelling, physically powerful, and secretive creature called Esti Capcaki, a name which roughly translates to "Furry Tall Man" or "Hairy Giant".

statement.id: Para kriptozoolog membuat klaim tak berdasar bahwa budaya Seminole dan Miccosukee memuat kisah makhluk berbau busuk, bertenaga fisik, dan tertutup bernama Esti Capcaki, yang kira-kira berarti 'Pria Tinggi Berbulu' atau 'Raksasa Berbulu'.
statement.en: Cryptozoologists have made unsubstantiated claims that Seminole and Miccosukee culture includes stories of a foul-smelling, physically powerful, and secretive creature called Esti Capcaki, roughly translated 'Furry Tall Man' or 'Hairy Giant'.

claims.quote: In the small community of Bardin, in Putnam County, Florida, beginning in the 1940s, there were a number of alleged sightings of a creature that came to be known as the Bardin Booger.

statement.id: Di komunitas kecil Bardin, Putnam County, Florida, sejak 1940-an terdapat sejumlah dugaan penampakan makhluk yang kemudian dikenal sebagai Bardin Booger.
statement.en: In the small community of Bardin, in Putnam County, Florida, beginning in the 1940s, there were a number of alleged sightings of a creature that came to be known as the Bardin Booger.

claims.quote: The skunk ape has been widely adopted across Florida as an unofficial mascot for wilderness and rural culture, including appearing in roadside businesses and attractions, television commercials, and on signs.

statement.id: Skunk ape telah diadopsi luas di seluruh Florida sebagai maskot tidak resmi budaya alam liar dan pedesaan, tampil di usaha dan atraksi tepi jalan, iklan televisi, dan papan penanda.
statement.en: The skunk ape has been widely adopted across Florida as an unofficial mascot for wilderness and rural culture, appearing in roadside businesses and attractions, television commercials, and on signs.

claims.quote: Within cryptozoology, the skunk ape is a mythical creature rumored to inhabit the forests and swamplands of Florida. Alleged sightings of the skunk ape have been reported throughout the state, with most concentrated in the Everglades region in southern Florida.

statement.id: Dalam kriptozoologi, skunk ape adalah makhluk mitos yang konon menghuni hutan dan rawa Florida; dugaan penampakannya dilaporkan di seluruh negara bagian, terbanyak di wilayah Everglades di Florida selatan.
statement.en: Within cryptozoology, the skunk ape is a mythical creature rumored to inhabit the forests and swamplands of Florida; alleged sightings have been reported throughout the state, most concentrated in the Everglades region in southern Florida.

claims.quote: The skunk ape is often considered a subtype of Bigfoot.

statement.id: Skunk ape sering dianggap sebagai subtipe Bigfoot.
statement.en: The skunk ape is often considered a subtype of Bigfoot.

claims.quote: Although the creature is best known as the skunk ape, a variety of other nicknames for this cryptid exist, including "Stink Ape," "Shaawanoki," "Swamp Monkey," "Swamp Man," "Swamp Monster," and "the Bardin Booger."

statement.id: Meski paling dikenal sebagai skunk ape, kriptid ini punya banyak julukan lain, termasuk 'Stink Ape', 'Shaawanoki', 'Swamp Monkey', 'Swamp Man', 'Swamp Monster', dan 'the Bardin Booger'.
statement.en: Although best known as the skunk ape, this cryptid has many other nicknames, including 'Stink Ape', 'Shaawanoki', 'Swamp Monkey', 'Swamp Man', 'Swamp Monster', and 'the Bardin Booger'.

claims.quote: Persons who claim to have seen the mysterious creature describe its physical appearance in a relatively consistent manner: a bipedal (upright-walking on two legs) figure that resembles an orangutan or gorilla, covered with shaggy hair or fur that ranges in color from brown to reddish to gray or black.

statement.id: Orang yang mengaku melihat makhluk misterius ini menggambarkan wujudnya secara cukup konsisten: sosok berkaki dua yang mirip orangutan atau gorila, tertutup rambut atau bulu lebat berwarna cokelat, kemerahan, abu-abu, atau hitam.
statement.en: Persons who claim to have seen the creature describe its appearance in a relatively consistent manner: a bipedal figure resembling an orangutan or gorilla, covered with shaggy hair or fur ranging in color from brown to reddish to gray or black.

claims.quote: A universal feature among all descriptions of the skunk ape among alleged witnesses is the presence of a very strong, foul odor that accompanies the beast. Witnesses describe this stench as resembling that of rotting food or garbage, decaying meat, rotten eggs, or methane.

statement.id: Ciri universal dalam semua deskripsi saksi adalah bau yang sangat kuat dan busuk yang menyertai makhluk itu, digambarkan seperti makanan atau sampah busuk, daging membusuk, telur busuk, atau metana.
statement.en: A universal feature among all descriptions of the skunk ape among alleged witnesses is a very strong, foul odor accompanying the beast, described as resembling rotting food or garbage, decaying meat, rotten eggs, or methane.

claims.quote: Cryptozoology enthusiasts have claimed that the term "Shaawanoki" of the Mikasuki language, refers to a legendary apelike creature. However, other reports suggest that this interpretation is mistaken, and the word instead refers to turtles or other established aquatic animals.

statement.id: Para peminat kriptozoologi mengklaim bahwa istilah 'Shaawanoki' dalam bahasa Mikasuki merujuk pada makhluk mirip kera; namun laporan lain menyebut tafsiran itu keliru dan kata itu justru merujuk pada kura-kura atau hewan air lain yang dikenal.
statement.en: Cryptozoology enthusiasts have claimed that the Mikasuki term 'Shaawanoki' refers to a legendary apelike creature, but other reports suggest this is mistaken and the word instead refers to turtles or other established aquatic animals.

claims.quote: Many skeptics argue that alleged sightings of the creature are most likely of black bears instead. The black bear is found in Florida, has dark hair that covers its entire body, and is capable of walking on its hind legs.

statement.id: Banyak skeptis berpendapat bahwa dugaan penampakan makhluk itu paling mungkin adalah beruang hitam, yang ada di Florida, berambut gelap menutupi seluruh tubuh, dan mampu berjalan dengan kaki belakang.
statement.en: Many skeptics argue that alleged sightings of the creature are most likely of black bears instead; the black bear is found in Florida, has dark hair covering its entire body, and can walk on its hind legs.

claims.quote: No nonhuman primate is known to be native to the United States or Canada, and no definitive evidence of a skunk ape (either physical or genetic) has ever been found

statement.id: Tidak ada primata bukan manusia yang diketahui asli Amerika Serikat atau Kanada, dan tak pernah ditemukan bukti pasti skunk ape, baik fisik maupun genetik.
statement.en: No nonhuman primate is known to be native to the United States or Canada, and no definitive evidence of a skunk ape, either physical or genetic, has ever been found.

claims.quote: In October 1977, Florida state representative Hugh Paul Nuckolls, a Republican from Fort Myers, introduced House Bill 1664 (nicknamed the "Skunk Ape Act" by the press) in the Florida State Legislature.

statement.id: Pada Oktober 1977, anggota DPR negara bagian Florida Hugh Paul Nuckolls, seorang Republikan dari Fort Myers, mengajukan RUU DPR 1664 (dijuluki 'Skunk Ape Act' oleh pers) di legislatif Florida.
statement.en: In October 1977, Florida state representative Hugh Paul Nuckolls, a Republican from Fort Myers, introduced House Bill 1664 (nicknamed the 'Skunk Ape Act' by the press) in the Florida State Legislature.

short_description.id: Tianma adalah kuda terbang dalam cerita rakyat Tiongkok, dengan sayap yang mungkin bersifat kiasan.
short_description.en: Tianma is a flying horse in Chinese folklore, with wings possibly understood metaphorically.

long_description.id: Tianma adalah kuda terbang dalam cerita rakyat Tiongkok, dengan sayap yang mungkin bersifat kiasan. Penggambarannya kadang memiliki ciri campuran seperti sisik naga. Menurut himne dalam sebuah teks klasik, ia turun dengan keringat merah, melintasi sepuluh ribu li, dan berkawan dengan naga.
long_description.en: Tianma is a flying horse in Chinese folklore, with wings possibly understood metaphorically. Its portrayal sometimes includes composite features such as dragon scales. According to hymns in a classical text, it descends with red sweat, crosses ten thousand li, and has the dragon as friend.

long_description.id: Keringat darah yang dilekatkan pada Tianma mungkin terinspirasi parasit pada kuda Ferghana. Dalam penggunaan zaman Zhou Barat, Tianma juga merujuk pada rasi. Teks sejarah klasik menyebut Dayuan memiliki kuda berkeringat darah yang leluhurnya dikatakan keturunan kuda langit, dan kuda Dayuan itu dinamai 天馬 oleh sang kaisar.
long_description.en: The blood-sweating attributed to Tianma may be inspired by parasites on Ferghana horses. In Western Zhou usage, Tianma also referred to a constellation. A classical history text says Dayuan has blood-sweating horses whose ancestor was said to be the offspring of the heavenly horse, and that the emperor named the Dayuan horses 天馬.

long_description.id: Himne lain menyebut kuda langit datang dari ujung barat melintasi pasir yang mengalir, berpunggung seperti harimau, dan menjadi perantara bagi naga menuju Kunlun. Artikel itu menghubungkan Tianma dengan Pegasus, dengan Kaisar Wu dari Han, dan dengan patung perunggu Kuda Terbang Gansu.
long_description.en: Other hymns say the heavenly horse comes from the far west across flowing sands, has a tiger-like spine, and acts as the dragon's guide toward Kunlun. The article connects Tianma with Pegasus, with Emperor Wu of Han, and with the bronze Flying Horse of Gansu.

claims.quote: Tianma (天馬 Tiānmǎ, "heavenly horse") was a winged (perhaps metaphorically) flying horse in Chinese folklore.

statement.id: Tianma adalah kuda terbang dalam cerita rakyat Tiongkok, dengan sayap yang mungkin bersifat kiasan.
statement.en: Tianma is a flying horse in Chinese folklore, with wings possibly understood metaphorically.

claims.quote: The Tianma is a flying horse that was sometimes depicted with chimerical features such as dragon scales and was at times attributed the ability to sweat blood, possibly inspired by the parasite Parafilaria multipapillosa, which infected the highly sought-after Ferghana horse (大宛馬), sometimes conflated with Tianma.

statement.id: Penggambarannya kadang memiliki ciri campuran seperti sisik naga.
statement.en: Its portrayal sometimes includes composite features such as dragon scales.

claims.quote: The Tianma is a flying horse that was sometimes depicted with chimerical features such as dragon scales and was at times attributed the ability to sweat blood, possibly inspired by the parasite Parafilaria multipapillosa, which infected the highly sought-after Ferghana horse (大宛馬), sometimes conflated with Tianma.

statement.id: Keringat darah yang dilekatkan pada Tianma mungkin terinspirasi parasit pada kuda Ferghana.
statement.en: The blood-sweating attributed to Tianma may be inspired by parasites on Ferghana horses.

claims.quote: In the Western Zhou Empire, Tianma referred to a constellation. Tianma is also associated with Emperor Wu of Han, an aficionado of the Central Asian horse, and the famous poet Li Bo. The bronze statue Flying Horse of Gansu is a well-known example.

statement.id: Dalam penggunaan zaman Zhou Barat, Tianma juga merujuk pada rasi.
statement.en: In Western Zhou usage, Tianma also referred to a constellation.

claims.quote: Tianma, the flying horse, is clearly connected to Pegasus from the Western Han dynasty artwork and in the Tang dynasty sources, as coming from Hellenized Central Asia.

statement.id: Menurut artikel itu, Tianma, kuda terbang, jelas terhubung dengan Pegasus dari karya seni dinasti Han Barat dan sumber dinasti Tang, sebagai berasal dari Asia Tengah yang terhelenisasi.
statement.en: According to the article, Tianma, the flying horse, is clearly connected to Pegasus from Western Han dynasty artwork and Tang dynasty sources, as coming from Hellenized Central Asia.

claims.quote: Tianma is also associated with Emperor Wu of Han, an aficionado of the Central Asian horse, and the famous poet Li Bo. The bronze statue Flying Horse of Gansu is a well-known example.

statement.id: Tianma juga dikaitkan dengan Kaisar Wu dari Han, penggemar kuda Asia Tengah, dan penyair terkenal Li Bo; patung perunggu Kuda Terbang Gansu adalah contoh yang terkenal.
statement.en: Tianma is also associated with Emperor Wu of Han, an aficionado of the Central Asian horse, and the famous poet Li Bo; the bronze statue Flying Horse of Gansu is a well-known example.

claims.quote: 初，天子發書易，云「神馬當從西北來」。得烏孫馬好，名曰「天馬」。及得大宛汗血馬，益壯，更名烏孫馬曰「西極」，名大宛馬曰「天馬」云。

statement.id: Dalam teks sejarah klasik ini, sang kaisar (天子) membuka naskah dan memperoleh bunyi "kuda dewa akan datang dari barat laut"; kuda Wusun (烏孫) yang baik dinamai "天馬", dan setelah mendapat kuda Dayuan (大宛) yang berkeringat darah (汗血) yang lebih gagah, kuda Wusun dinamai ulang "西極" dan kuda Dayuan dinamai "天馬".
statement.en: In this classical history text, the emperor (天子) consults a text that says "divine horses will come from the northwest"; good Wusun (烏孫) horses are named "天馬", and after obtaining stronger blood-sweating (汗血) Dayuan (大宛) horses, the Wusun horses are renamed "西極" and the Dayuan horses are named "天馬".

claims.quote: 大宛在匈奴西南，在漢正西，去漢可萬里 ... 多善馬，馬汗血，其先天馬子也。

statement.id: Teks sejarah klasik ini menyebut Dayuan (大宛) terletak di barat daya Xiongnu dan tepat di barat Han, memiliki banyak kuda bagus yang berkeringat darah (馬汗血), dan leluhurnya dikatakan keturunan kuda langit (天馬子).
statement.en: This classical history text says Dayuan (大宛) lies southwest of the Xiongnu and due west of Han, has many fine horses that sweat blood (馬汗血), and that their ancestor was the offspring of the heavenly horse (天馬子).

claims.quote: 太一況，天馬下，霑赤汗，沬流赭。志俶儻，精權奇，逦浮雲，晻上馳。體容與，迣萬里，今安匹，龍為友。〈元狩三年馬生渥洼水中作。〉

statement.id: Sebuah himne dalam teks klasik ini menyebut kuda langit (天馬) turun dengan keringat merah (赤汗) dan busa mengalir kemerahan, melintasi sepuluh ribu li (萬里), dan berkawan dengan naga (龍為友); catatan anotasinya menyebut himne itu dibuat pada tahun ketiga Yuanshou (元狩三年) ketika seekor kuda lahir di air Wowa (渥洼水).
statement.en: A hymn in this classical text says the heavenly horse (天馬) descends with red sweat (赤汗) and ochre-colored foam, crosses ten thousand li (萬里), and has the dragon as friend (龍為友); its annotation says it was composed in the third year of Yuanshou (元狩三年) when a horse was born in the Wowa water (渥洼水).

claims.quote: 天馬徠，從西極，涉流沙，九夷服。天馬徠，出泉水，虎脊兩，化若鬼。

statement.id: Himne lain menyebut kuda langit (天馬) datang dari ujung barat (西極) melintasi pasir yang mengalir, muncul dari air mata air, berpunggung seperti harimau (虎脊), dan perubahannya seperti hantu (化若鬼).
statement.en: Another hymn says the heavenly horse (天馬) comes from the far west (西極), crosses the flowing sands, emerges from spring water, has a tiger-like spine (虎脊), and transforms like a ghost or spirit (化若鬼).

claims.quote: 天馬徠，開遠門，竦予身，逝昆侖。天馬徠，龍之媒，游閶闔，觀玉臺。〈太初四年誅宛王獲宛馬作。〉

statement.id: Himne berikutnya menyebut kuda langit (天馬) datang menuju Kunlun (昆侖), menjadi perantara bagi naga (龍之媒), mengembara di gerbang langit (閶闔) dan memandang teras giok (玉臺); anotasinya menyebut himne itu dibuat pada tahun keempat Taichu (太初四年) ketika raja Dayuan (宛王) dihukum dan kuda Dayuan diperoleh.
statement.en: The next hymn says the heavenly horse (天馬) comes toward Kunlun (昆侖), acts as the dragon's matchmaker or guide (龍之媒), roams the gate of heaven (閶闔) and views the jade terrace (玉臺); its annotation says it was composed in the fourth year of Taichu (太初四年) when the king of Dayuan (宛王) was executed and Dayuan horses were obtained.

short_description.id: Wendigo adalah makhluk mitologis atau roh jahat dari cerita rakyat Algonquian, dipandang sebagai makhluk gaib pemakan manusia yang dikaitkan dengan musim dingin dan kelaparan.
short_description.en: The wendigo is a mythological creature or evil spirit of Algonquian folklore, seen as a cannibalistic supernatural being linked with winter and famine.

long_description.id: Wendigo adalah bagian dari sistem kepercayaan tradisional beberapa bangsa penutur bahasa Algonquian, termasuk Ojibwe, Saulteaux, Cree, Naskapi, dan Innu. Ia sering dikatakan roh jahat, kadang digambarkan sebagai makhluk bersifat manusiawi, yang dapat merasuki manusia. Pada semua budaya itu ia dipandang sebagai makhluk gaib yang jahat dan kanibal, sangat dikaitkan dengan utara, musim dingin, kelaparan, dan paceklik. Sumber lain menyebutnya monster rakus Bangsa-Bangsa Pertama Kanada dan budaya Indian Dataran yang muncul dengan nama lain dalam kisah banyak bangsa Pribumi Amerika.
long_description.en: The wendigo belongs to the traditional belief system of several Algonquian-speaking peoples, among them the Ojibwe, Saulteaux, Cree, Naskapi and Innu. It is often called a malevolent spirit, sometimes pictured with human-like traits, that can possess people. Across these cultures it is seen as an evil, cannibalistic supernatural being tied closely to the north, winter and famine. Another source calls it a voracious monster of the First Nations of Canada and Plains Indian culture, found under other names in many Native American nations.

long_description.id: Korbannya dikatakan merasakan lapar yang tak terpuaskan, keinginan memakan manusia lain, dan kecenderungan membunuh. Dalam sebagian gambaran, wendigo adalah humanoid raksasa berhati es yang kedatangannya ditandai bau busuk atau hawa dingin tak lazim. Dalam kisah Ojibwe, Cree, Naskapi, dan Innu, ia sering digambarkan raksasa yang membesar sebanding dengan santapannya sehingga tak pernah kenyang.
long_description.en: Its victims are said to feel insatiable hunger, a wish to eat other humans, and a tendency to murder. In some depictions the wendigo is a giant humanoid with a heart of ice whose approach is marked by a foul stench or an unseasonable chill. In Ojibwe, Cree, Naskapi and Innu lore it is often a giant that swells with each meal, so it is never full.

long_description.id: Mengenai asalnya, dalam sebagian tradisi manusia yang dikuasai keserakahan dapat menjadi wendigo, sedangkan sumber lain menyebut wendigo tercipta ketika seseorang memakan sesamanya demi bertahan hidup. Menurut Chippewa, wendigo dulunya manusia yang tak pernah puas dan sangat egois. Makhluk ini dipandang sebagai perwujudan kerakusan dan keserakahan.
long_description.en: On its origin, in some traditions humans overcome by greed could become wendigos, while other sources say a wendigo arose when someone turned to cannibalism to survive. According to the Chippewa, the wendigo was once a human who was never satisfied and highly selfish. It is regarded as the embodiment of gluttony and greed.

long_description.id: Di kalangan Assiniboine, Cree, dan Ojibwe, tarian upacara satir kadang dipentaskan pada masa paceklik untuk menegaskan pantangan wendigo. Dalam psikiatri modern dikenal pula "psikosis wendigo", yang keberadaannya diperdebatkan. Di luar tradisi aslinya, wendigo banyak muncul dalam sastra dan budaya populer.
long_description.en: Among the Assiniboine, Cree and Ojibwe, a satirical ceremonial dance is sometimes held in times of famine to underline the wendigo taboo. Modern psychiatry also knows a "Wendigo psychosis", whose reality is disputed. Beyond its original tradition the wendigo features widely in literature and popular culture.

cultural_context.id: Kisah asal-usul Chippewa dan kisah serupa dari bangsa lain, menurut salah satu sumber, memperkuat gagasan bahwa kebutuhan komunitas didahulukan daripada individu; wendigo sebagai makhluk rakus menjadi kebalikan nilai itu. Sebagai konsep, wendigo juga dipakai untuk menyebut orang, gagasan, atau gerakan yang dikuasai keserakahan dan konsumsi berlebihan.
cultural_context.en: One source says the Chippewa origin tale and similar tales from other nations reinforce the idea that the community's needs outrank the individual's, with the ravenous wendigo standing as the opposite of that value. As a concept, the wendigo is also used for any person, idea or movement gripped by greed and overconsumption.

literal_meaning.id: Kata Inggris wendigo serapan dari Cree dan Ojibwe; kamus Ojibwe mendefinisikan wiindigoo sebagai 'windigo: monster kanibal musim dingin'
literal_meaning.en: The English word is borrowed from Cree and Ojibwe; the Ojibwe dictionary defines wiindigoo as 'windigo: a winter cannibal monster'

claims.quote: The wendigo is part of the traditional belief system of several Algonquian-speaking peoples, including the Ojibwe, the Saulteaux, the Cree, the Naskapi, and the Innu.

statement.id: Wendigo adalah bagian dari sistem kepercayaan tradisional suku-suku Algonquian-speaking termasuk Ojibwe dan Cree.
statement.en: The wendigo is part of the traditional belief system of several Algonquian-speaking peoples including the Ojibwe and Cree.

claims.quote: The wendigo is often said to be a malevolent spirit, sometimes depicted as a creature with human-like characteristics, who may possess human beings.

statement.id: Wendigo sering digambarkan sebagai roh jahat yang mampu merasuki manusia.
statement.en: The wendigo is often said to be a malevolent spirit who may possess human beings.

claims.quote: It is said to cause its victims a feeling of insatiable hunger, the desire to eat other humans, and the propensity to commit murder.

statement.id: Makhluk ini menyebabkan rasa lapar kanibal tak terpuaskan dan dorongan untuk membunuh.
statement.en: It is said to cause its victims insatiable hunger, the desire to eat other humans, and propensity to commit murder.

claims.quote: In some representations, the wendigo is described as a giant humanoid with a heart of ice, whose approach is signaled by a foul stench or sudden unseasonable chill.

statement.id: Dalam beberapa penggambaran, wendigo dilukiskan sebagai sosok raksasa berhati es dengan bau busuk atau hawa dingin tiba-tiba.
statement.en: In some representations, the wendigo is described as a giant humanoid with a heart of ice signaled by foul stench or chill.

claims.quote: is a mythological creature or evil spirit originating from Algonquian folklore.

statement.id: Wendigo adalah makhluk mitologis atau roh jahat yang berasal dari cerita rakyat Algonquian.
statement.en: The wendigo is a mythological creature or evil spirit originating from Algonquian folklore.

claims.quote: The contemporary English word wendigo is a loanword from multiple origins. It is partially a borrowing from Cree (wīhtikōw ) and partially a borrowing from Ojibwe (wiindigoo ), both Algonquian languages.

statement.id: Kata Inggris wendigo sebagian merupakan serapan dari bahasa Cree (wīhtikōw) dan sebagian dari bahasa Ojibwe (wiindigoo), keduanya bahasa Algonquian.
statement.en: The English word wendigo is partly a borrowing from Cree (wīhtikōw) and partly from Ojibwe (wiindigoo), both Algonquian languages.

claims.quote: The form wendigo was popularized in the English language by Algernon Blackwood, who in 1910 published the novella The Wendigo.

statement.id: Bentuk wendigo dipopulerkan dalam bahasa Inggris oleh Algernon Blackwood, yang pada 1910 menerbitkan novela The Wendigo.
statement.en: The form wendigo was popularized in English by Algernon Blackwood, who in 1910 published the novella The Wendigo.

claims.quote: common to all these cultures is the view that the wendigo is a malevolent, cannibalistic, supernatural being. They were strongly associated with the north, winter, cold, famine, and starvation.

statement.id: Pandangan yang sama di semua budaya itu adalah bahwa wendigo makhluk gaib jahat pemakan manusia, yang sangat dikaitkan dengan utara, musim dingin, hawa dingin, kelaparan, dan paceklik.
statement.en: Common to all these cultures is the view that the wendigo is a malevolent, cannibalistic, supernatural being, strongly associated with the north, winter, cold, famine and starvation.

claims.quote: In Ojibwe, Eastern Cree, Westmain Swampy Cree, Naskapi, and Innu lore, wendigos are often described as giants that are many times larger than human beings

statement.id: Dalam kisah Ojibwe, Cree Timur, Cree Rawa Westmain, Naskapi, dan Innu, wendigo sering digambarkan sebagai raksasa yang berkali-kali lipat lebih besar daripada manusia.
statement.en: In Ojibwe, Eastern Cree, Westmain Swampy Cree, Naskapi and Innu lore, wendigos are often described as giants many times larger than human beings.

claims.quote: Whenever a wendigo ate another person, it would grow in proportion to the meal it had just eaten, so it could never be full.

statement.id: Setiap kali wendigo memakan seseorang, ia tumbuh sebanding dengan santapannya sehingga tidak pernah kenyang.
statement.en: Whenever a wendigo ate another person it would grow in proportion to the meal, so it could never be full.

claims.quote: The wendigo is seen as the embodiment of gluttony, greed, and excess.

statement.id: Wendigo dipandang sebagai perwujudan kerakusan, keserakahan, dan kelebihan.
statement.en: The wendigo is seen as the embodiment of gluttony, greed and excess.

claims.quote: A wendigo need not lose the human's powers of cognition or speech and in some depictions may clearly communicate with its prospective victims or even threaten or taunt them.

statement.id: Wendigo tidak harus kehilangan daya pikir atau bicara manusia, dan dalam sebagian gambaran ia dapat berkomunikasi dengan calon korbannya, bahkan mengancam atau mengejek mereka.
statement.en: A wendigo need not lose the human's powers of cognition or speech, and in some depictions may communicate with prospective victims or even threaten or taunt them.

claims.quote: A specimen of folk story collected in the early 20th century by Lottie Chicogquaw Marsden, an ethnographer of the Chippewas of Rama First Nation, in which a wendigo also exhibits tool use, an ability to survive partial dismemberment, and autocannibalism

statement.id: Sebuah cerita rakyat yang dikumpulkan pada awal abad ke-20 oleh Lottie Chicogquaw Marsden, etnografer Chippewas of Rama First Nation, menampilkan wendigo yang memakai alat, mampu bertahan setelah tubuhnya sebagian terpotong, dan memakan dirinya sendiri.
statement.en: A folk story collected in the early 20th century by Lottie Chicogquaw Marsden, an ethnographer of the Chippewas of Rama First Nation, shows a wendigo using tools, surviving partial dismemberment and practising autocannibalism.

claims.quote: One time long ago a big Windigo stole an Indian boy, but the boy was too thin, so the Windigo didn't eat him up right away, but he travelled with the Indian boy waiting for him till he'd get fat.

statement.id: Dalam cerita itu, seorang Windigo besar menculik seorang anak laki-laki tetapi tidak langsung memakannya karena anak itu terlalu kurus, sehingga ia membawanya berkelana menunggu anak itu gemuk.
statement.en: In that story a big Windigo stole a boy but did not eat him right away because the boy was too thin, so he travelled with him waiting till he got fat.

claims.quote: The Indians then killed him and cut him to pieces. This was the end of this Giant Windigo.

statement.id: Pada akhir cerita, orang-orang membunuh Windigo itu dan memotongnya menjadi beberapa bagian; itulah akhir Windigo raksasa itu.
statement.en: At the end of the story the people killed the Windigo and cut him to pieces; that was the end of this Giant Windigo.

claims.quote: In some traditions, humans overpowered by greed could turn into wendigos; the myth thus served as a method of encouraging cooperation and moderation. Other sources say wendigos were created when a human resorted to cannibalism to survive.

statement.id: Dalam sebagian tradisi, manusia yang dikuasai keserakahan dapat menjadi wendigo, sehingga mitos ini mendorong kerja sama dan kesederhanaan; sumber lain menyebut wendigo tercipta ketika manusia memakan sesamanya demi bertahan hidup.
statement.en: In some traditions humans overpowered by greed could turn into wendigos, so the myth encouraged cooperation and moderation; other sources say wendigos were created when a human resorted to cannibalism to survive.

claims.quote: Humans could also turn into wendigos by being in contact with them for too long.

statement.id: Manusia juga dapat menjadi wendigo karena terlalu lama berhubungan dengan mereka.
statement.en: Humans could also turn into wendigos by being in contact with them for too long.

claims.quote: Among the Assiniboine, the Cree, and the Ojibwe, a satirical ceremonial dance is sometimes performed during times of famine to reinforce the seriousness of the wendigo taboo.

statement.id: Di kalangan Assiniboine, Cree, dan Ojibwe, tarian upacara satir kadang dipentaskan pada masa paceklik untuk menegaskan keseriusan pantangan wendigo.
statement.en: Among the Assiniboine, Cree and Ojibwe a satirical ceremonial dance is sometimes performed during famine to reinforce the seriousness of the wendigo taboo.

claims.quote: The last known wendigo ceremony conducted in the United States was at Lake Windigo of Star Island of Cass Lake, within the Leech Lake Indian Reservation in northern Minnesota.

statement.id: Upacara wendigo terakhir yang diketahui di Amerika Serikat dilakukan di Lake Windigo di Star Island, Cass Lake, dalam Reservasi Indian Leech Lake di Minnesota utara.
statement.en: The last known wendigo ceremony in the United States was held at Lake Windigo on Star Island of Cass Lake, within the Leech Lake Indian Reservation in northern Minnesota.

claims.quote: In modern psychiatry, the disorder known as "Wendigo psychosis" is characterized by symptoms such as an intense craving for human flesh and fear of becoming a cannibal. Wendigo psychosis is described as a culture-bound syndrome.

statement.id: Dalam psikiatri modern, gangguan yang dikenal sebagai "psikosis wendigo" dicirikan oleh gejala seperti nafsu kuat terhadap daging manusia dan ketakutan menjadi kanibal, dan digambarkan sebagai sindrom terikat budaya.
statement.en: In modern psychiatry the disorder known as "Wendigo psychosis" is characterized by symptoms such as an intense craving for human flesh and fear of becoming a cannibal, and is described as a culture-bound syndrome.

claims.quote: Some researchers argued that, essentially, Wendigo psychosis was a fabrication, the result of naïve anthropologists taking stories related to them at face value without observation.

statement.id: Sebagian peneliti berpendapat bahwa psikosis wendigo pada dasarnya rekaan, hasil antropolog naif yang menelan mentah-mentah cerita tanpa pengamatan.
statement.en: Some researchers argued that Wendigo psychosis was essentially a fabrication, the result of naive anthropologists taking stories at face value without observation.

claims.quote: Others cited several credible eyewitness accounts by Algonquians and others, as evidence that wendigo psychosis was a factual historical phenomenon.

statement.id: Peneliti lain mengutip beberapa kesaksian saksi mata yang kredibel dari orang Algonquian dan lainnya sebagai bukti bahwa psikosis wendigo adalah fenomena sejarah yang nyata.
statement.en: Others cited several credible eyewitness accounts by Algonquians and others as evidence that wendigo psychosis was a factual historical phenomenon.

claims.quote: As a concept, the wendigo can apply to any person, idea, or movement infected by a corrosive drive toward self-aggrandizing greed and excessive consumption, traits that sow disharmony and destruction if left unchecked.

statement.id: Sebagai konsep, wendigo dapat merujuk pada orang, gagasan, atau gerakan mana pun yang terjangkit dorongan merusak berupa keserakahan yang mementingkan diri dan konsumsi berlebihan, sifat yang menabur ketidakselarasan dan kehancuran bila dibiarkan.
statement.en: As a concept the wendigo can apply to any person, idea or movement infected by a corrosive drive toward self-aggrandizing greed and excessive consumption, traits that sow disharmony and destruction if left unchecked.

claims.quote: The wechuge is a similar being that appears in the legends of the Athabaskan people of the Northwest Pacific Coast. It too is cannibalistic; however, it is characterized as enlightened with ancestral insights.

statement.id: Wechuge adalah makhluk serupa dalam legenda bangsa Athabaskan di Pesisir Pasifik Barat Laut; ia juga kanibal, tetapi dicirikan sebagai tercerahkan dengan wawasan leluhur.
statement.en: The wechuge is a similar being in the legends of the Athabaskan people of the Northwest Pacific Coast; it too is cannibalistic but is characterized as enlightened with ancestral insights.

statement.en: The infobox lists the sub-grouping as Algonquian, with origin region Canada and United States.

statement.id: Bentuk yang sebanding sudah ada dalam bahasa Inggris sejak 1714 (Whitego).
statement.en: Comparable forms have existed in English since 1714 (Whitego).

claims.quote: one of the first appearances of a character inspired by, or named after, a wendigo in non-Indigenous literature is Algernon Blackwood's 1910 novella The Wendigo.

statement.id: Salah satu kemunculan pertama tokoh yang terinspirasi atau dinamai wendigo dalam sastra non-Pribumi adalah novela The Wendigo karya Algernon Blackwood tahun 1910, yang berbeda dari wujudnya dalam cerita rakyat tradisional.
statement.en: One of the first appearances of a character inspired by or named after a wendigo in non-Indigenous literature is Algernon Blackwood's 1910 novella The Wendigo, distinct from the wendigo of traditional lore.

claims.quote: These works set the template for later portrayals in popular culture, at times even replacing the Native American lore.

statement.id: Karya-karya itu menjadi cetak biru bagi penggambaran budaya populer berikutnya, kadang bahkan menggantikan cerita rakyat Pribumi Amerika.
statement.en: These works set the template for later portrayals in popular culture, at times even replacing the Native American lore.

statement.id: Wendigo adalah monster rakus dari budaya Bangsa-Bangsa Pertama Kanada dan Indian Dataran yang muncul, dengan nama lain, dalam kisah banyak bangsa Pribumi Amerika di seluruh Amerika Utara.
statement.en: The Wendigo is a voracious monster of the First Nations of Canada and Plains Indians culture who appears, under other names, in the stories of many Native American Nations across North America.

claims.quote: According to the Chippewa, the Wendigo was once a human who could never be satisfied and was characterized by excessive selfishness and greed. Such people were thought to eventually become the human-eating monster with a heart of ice who preys upon people.

statement.id: Menurut Chippewa, Wendigo dulunya manusia yang tak pernah puas dan bercirikan keegoisan dan keserakahan berlebihan; orang seperti itu dipercaya akhirnya menjadi monster pemakan manusia berhati es yang memangsa orang.
statement.en: According to the Chippewa, the Wendigo was once a human who could never be satisfied, marked by excessive selfishness and greed; such people were thought to eventually become the human-eating monster with a heart of ice who preys upon people.

claims.quote: The creature is depicted as an emaciated beast with large horns who is never satiated no matter how much it eats and so is doomed to wander about constantly trying and failing to satisfy its need for comfort.

statement.id: Makhluk ini digambarkan sebagai binatang kurus kering bertanduk besar yang tak pernah kenyang berapa pun yang dimakannya, sehingga terus mengembara dan gagal memenuhi kebutuhannya akan kenyamanan.
statement.en: The creature is depicted as an emaciated beast with large horns that is never satiated no matter how much it eats, and so is doomed to wander constantly, failing to satisfy its need for comfort.

claims.quote: The Chippewa origin tale of the monster is echoed by other Nations and serves to reinforce the concept generally held by Native Americans that the needs of the community come before those of the individual.

statement.id: Kisah asal-usul monster dari Chippewa digaungkan bangsa lain dan memperkuat gagasan umum di kalangan Pribumi Amerika bahwa kebutuhan komunitas didahulukan daripada kebutuhan individu.
statement.en: The Chippewa origin tale of the monster is echoed by other Nations and reinforces the concept generally held by Native Americans that the needs of the community come before those of the individual.

claims.quote: The Flying Head (or Flying Heads) is similar to the Wendigo in that it is also an insatiable monster that feeds on human flesh. The creature originates in the legends of the Iroquois Nation

statement.id: Kepala Terbang (Flying Head) mirip Wendigo karena juga monster yang tak pernah puas dan memakan daging manusia, dan berasal dari legenda bangsa Iroquois.
statement.en: The Flying Head is similar to the Wendigo in that it is also an insatiable monster that feeds on human flesh, and it originates in the legends of the Iroquois Nation.

short_description.id: Aderyn y Corff ("burung mayat" dalam bahasa Welsh) adalah burung dalam folklor Welsh yang menjadi pertanda kematian.
short_description.en: The Aderyn y Corff (Welsh for 'corpse bird') is a bird of Welsh folklore that foretells death.

long_description.id: Aderyn y Corff, dalam bahasa Welsh berarti "burung mayat" (juga Aderyn corff, Deryn corff, atau kuno Aderyn y Corph), adalah burung dalam folklor Welsh yang menandakan kematian. Ia konon berkicau di depan pintu orang yang akan segera meninggal dengan suara mirip kata dewch ("datanglah"). Burung ini tidak berbulu dan tidak bersayap; bila tidak sedang berseru di depan pintu, ia dikatakan hidup di alam lain.
long_description.en: The Aderyn y Corff, Welsh for 'corpse bird' (also Aderyn corff, Deryn corff, or archaically Aderyn y Corph), is a bird of Welsh folklore that heralds death. It is said to call outside the door of someone soon to die with a cry like dewch, 'come'. It has neither feathers nor wings, and when not crying at a door it is said to dwell on another plane.

long_description.id: Burung ini disebut dua kali dalam Alkitab berbahasa Welsh, yang oleh sebagian penulis dianggap asal takhayul tersebut. Banyak kisah modern menduga burung mayat sebenarnya burung hantu yang tertarik oleh cahaya dari kamar orang sakit. Artikel es menyebut salah satu sumber penting tentangnya adalah British Goblins (1881) karya Wirt Sikes.
long_description.en: It is mentioned twice in the Welsh-language Bible, which some authors take to be the root of the superstition. Many later accounts suppose the corpse bird was really a screech owl drawn by light from a sick person's room. The es article names Wirt Sikes's British Goblins (1881) as a key source on it.

long_description.id: Wirt Sikes mencatat bahwa dalam tradisi kuno burung ini tidak berbulu dan tidak bersayap, melayang tanpa tumpuan di langit dan, bila tidak mengemban pesan duniawi, tinggal di negeri ilusi dan khayal. Ia menulis bahwa di Wales pertanda kematian berwujud sosok-sosok yang khas dan mencolok, serta mengaitkan burung ini dengan takhayul burung hantu pekik.
long_description.en: Wirt Sikes records that in ancient tradition the bird had no feathers or wings, soared without support in the heavens and, when not on an earthly message, dwelt in the land of illusion and phantasy. He writes that in Wales death portents take distinct and striking individualities, and links this bird with the screech-owl superstition.

long_description.id: Elias Owen, yang menyebutnya Deryn Corph, menulis bahwa burung ini datang mengepakkan sayap ke jendela kamar orang sakit dan kedatangannya dianggap pertanda pasti kematian. Ia juga menulis bahwa burung yang dipilih untuk peran itu adalah burung hantu cokelat atau burung hantu pekik.
long_description.en: Elias Owen, who calls it the Deryn Corph, writes that the bird came flapping its wings against the window of a sick person's room and its visit was considered a certain omen of death. He also writes that the bird singled out for that role was the tawny, or screech owl.

short_description.id: Areop-Enap, "laba-laba tua" dalam bahasa Nauru, berperan besar dalam penciptaan dunia menurut mitos masyarakat pribumi Nauru.
short_description.en: According to the indigenous myths of Nauru, Areop-Enap (Nauruan for "old spider") had a leading role in making the world.

long_description.id: Dalam mitos masyarakat pribumi Nauru, Areop-Enap (bahasa Nauru: "laba-laba tua") berperan besar dalam penciptaan dunia. Pada awalnya hanya ada Areop-Enap, seekor laba-laba, dan laut. Dixon mencatat bahwa ia melayang di atas dalam ruang tanpa batas.
long_description.en: In the indigenous myths of the people of Nauru, Areop-Enap (Nauruan: "old spider") plays a major part in the creation of the world. At the beginning only Areop-Enap, a spider, and the sea existed. Dixon records that he floated above in endless space.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah penciptaan, Areop-Enap mencari makanan dalam kegelapan dan menemukan kerang raksasa yang menelannya. Setelah merapal mantra kekuatan pada cacing bernama Rigi, ia membujuk Rigi mencoba membuka kerang itu; asinnya air membunuh kerang dan membuka cangkangnya. Cangkang bawah menjadi Bumi dan cangkang atas menjadi langit, siput yang lebih kecil menjadi Bulan di barat, dan siput kedua menjadi Matahari di timur. Dalam versi Dixon, Rigi kelelahan karena kerja kerasnya dan mati setelah cangkang atas terangkat menjadi langit.
long_description.en: In the creation tale Areop-Enap went looking for food in the dark and came upon an enormous clam, which swallowed him. After he cast a strength spell on a worm called Rigi and persuaded him to try to open the clam, the briny water killed the clam and its shell opened. The lower shell became the Earth and the upper shell the sky, the smaller snail became the Moon in the west, and the second snail became the Sun in the east. In Dixon's version Rigi, worn out by his labor, died after the upper shell was raised to become the sky.

long_description.id: Areop-Enap membuat pulau-pulau dari daging kerang dan menyelimutinya dengan tumbuhan dari benang jaringnya, lalu membungkus Rigi yang tewas dalam kepompong sutra dan menggantungnya di langit menjadi Bima Sakti. Ia menciptakan manusia dari batu agar menopang langit. Setelah itu ia menemukan makhluk-makhluk lain di dunia baru dan menciptakan makhluk bersayap dari kotoran di bawah kukunya untuk mengetahui nama-nama penghuni dunia.
long_description.en: Areop-Enap made islands from clam-flesh and clothed them with vegetation from his web-thread, then wrapped the dead Rigi in a silk cocoon and hung him in the sky as the Milky Way. He created humans from stones to support the sky. He then found other creatures in the new world and made a winged creature from the dirt under his nails to learn the names of the world's inhabitants.

statement.en: The saltiness of the water killed the clam and opened the shell. Areop-Enap made the lower shell into Earth and the upper shell into the sky, set the smaller snail west of the sky-shell where it became the Moon, and set the second snail to the east where it became the Sun.

claims.quote: Areop-Enap made islands from clam-flesh and clothed them in vegetation made from his own web-thread.

statement.id: Areop-Enap membuat pulau-pulau dari daging kerang dan menyelimutinya dengan tumbuhan yang dibuat dari benang jaringnya sendiri.
statement.en: Areop-Enap made islands from clam-flesh and clothed them in vegetation made from his own web-thread.

claims.quote: Finally he turned to Rigi and found that he had drowned in his own sweat, killed by his own exertions. Areop-Enap wrapped him in a cocoon of silk and hung him in the sky to become the Milky Way.

statement.id: Akhirnya ia menoleh kepada Rigi dan mendapati bahwa Rigi tenggelam dalam keringatnya sendiri, tewas karena jerih payahnya. Areop-Enap membungkusnya dalam kepompong sutra dan menggantungnya di langit menjadi Bima Sakti.
statement.en: Finally he turned to Rigi and found that he had drowned in his own sweat, killed by his own exertions. Areop-Enap wrapped him in a silk cocoon and hung him in the sky to become the Milky Way.

claims.quote: So he created a winged creature or flying bird from the dirt under his nails and set it to annoy the creatures so that they called to each other to kill it. In this way Areop-Enap learned the names of the inhabitants of the world.

statement.id: Maka ia menciptakan makhluk bersayap atau burung terbang dari kotoran di bawah kukunya dan menyuruhnya mengganggu makhluk-makhluk itu sehingga mereka saling memanggil untuk membunuhnya. Dengan cara ini Areop-Enap mengetahui nama-nama penghuni dunia.
statement.en: So he created a winged creature or flying bird from the dirt under his nails and set it to annoy the creatures so that they called to each other to kill it. In this way Areop-Enap learned the names of the inhabitants of the world.

claims.quote: in the beginning there were only the sea and Areop-Enap, ‘Ancient Spider,” who floated above in endless space.

statement.id: Dalam kisah yang dicatat Dixon, pada mulanya hanya ada laut dan Areop-Enap, "Laba-laba Purba", yang melayang di atas dalam ruang tanpa batas.
statement.en: In the tale recorded by Dixon, in the beginning there were only the sea and Areop-Enap, "Ancient Spider", who floated above in endless space.

claims.quote: At last he raised the upper shell very high, and it became the sky; but Rigi, the worm, exhausted by his great work, fell and died. From the other snail Ancient Spider now made the sun and set it on the east side of the lower shell, which became the earth.

statement.id: Dalam versi Dixon, cangkang atas diangkat sangat tinggi dan menjadi langit, tetapi Rigi, si cacing, kelelahan karena kerja kerasnya, jatuh dan mati. Dari siput yang lain Laba-laba Purba membuat matahari dan menaruhnya di sisi timur cangkang bawah, yang menjadi bumi.
statement.en: In Dixon's version the upper shell was raised very high and became the sky, but Rigi the worm, exhausted by his great work, fell and died; from the other snail Ancient Spider made the sun and set it on the east side of the lower shell, which became the earth.

claims.quote: Ancient Spider turned stones into men; but these became the supporters of the heavens and were not ordinary human beings.
claims.locator: Chapter on the creation of mankind

statement.id: Menurut Dixon, Laba-laba Purba mengubah batu menjadi manusia, tetapi mereka menjadi penopang langit dan bukan manusia biasa.
statement.en: According to Dixon, Ancient Spider turned stones into men, but these became the supporters of the heavens and were not ordinary human beings.

claims.quote: Thus, Ancient Spider set out, after the world was created, to see if there were any other beings beside himself, and he came to a land where he found men and women sitting on the shore in the shade of the trees.
claims.locator: Chapter on the creation of mankind

statement.id: Menurut Dixon, setelah dunia tercipta Laba-laba Purba pergi untuk melihat apakah ada makhluk lain selain dirinya, dan ia tiba di sebuah negeri tempat ia mendapati laki-laki dan perempuan duduk di pantai di bawah naungan pohon.
statement.en: According to Dixon, after the world was created Ancient Spider set out to see whether there were other beings besides himself, and came to a land where he found men and women sitting on the shore in the shade of the trees.

claims.quote: (“Young Spider”) was born miraculously from a boil upon Dabage, the tortoise;

statement.id: Menurut Dixon, "Young Spider" lahir secara ajaib dari bisul pada Dabage, si kura-kura.
statement.en: According to Dixon, "Young Spider" was born miraculously from a boil on Dabage, the tortoise.

topic.id: Penciptaan manusia dan penemuan makhluk lain
topic.en: The creation of humans and the discovery of other beings

short_description.id: Ashite Kōjin adalah dewa tangan dan kaki dalam kepercayaan rakyat; orang memohon kesembuhan penyakit atau cedera tangan dan kaki dan mempersembahkan cetakan tangan atau kaki.
short_description.en: Ashite Kōjin is a hand-and-foot deity of folk belief; people pray for recovery from hand and foot ailments and injuries and offer hand or foot models.

long_description.id: Ashite Kōjin adalah dewa tangan dan kaki yang berakar pada kepercayaan rakyat. Orang yang menderita penyakit atau cedera tangan dan kaki memohon kesembuhan dan mempersembahkan cetakan tangan atau kaki, kadang gips atau tongkat penyangga. Kepercayaan ini dilaporkan di Akita, Fukuoka, Kumamoto, dan Ōita, bahkan Shikoku, dan Kuil Kai di Kumamoto termasuk yang disebut "Ashite Kōjin".
long_description.en: Ashite Kōjin is a hand-and-foot deity rooted in folk belief. People suffering from hand and foot ailments or injuries pray for recovery and offer hand or foot models, sometimes casts or crutches. The belief is reported in Akita, Fukuoka, Kumamoto and Ōita, even Shikoku, and Kai Shrine in Kumamoto is among those commonly called "Ashite Kōjin".

long_description.id: Wujud pemujaannya beragam. Di sebagian kuil, Shōmen Kongō dipuja sebagai Ashite Kōjin; di 西巌殿寺 objeknya batu suci bulat bernama Okagami-ishi. Kuil Kai di Kashima, yang memuja panglima 甲斐親英 (宗立) yang konon tewas karena luka tangan dan kaki, menyebut dirinya kuil induk dan banyak Ashite Kōjin lain di Kumamoto disebut pembagian rohnya.
long_description.en: The forms of veneration vary. At some temples Shōmen Kongō is enshrined as Ashite Kōjin; at 西巌殿寺 the object is a round sacred stone called Okagami-ishi. Kai Shrine in Kashima, which enshrines the warlord 甲斐親英 (宗立) said to have died of injuries to his hands and feet, calls itself the head shrine, and many other Ashite Kōjin in Kumamoto are said to be branch spirits from it.

long_description.id: Di Beppu, kepercayaan serupa disebut "手足荒神". Menurut kisah asalnya, seorang samurai yang patah tangan dan kakinya sebelum Pertempuran Ishigakibaru pada 1600 berjanji bahwa rohnya akan menolong orang yang terkilir; setelah orang sembuh setelah berziarah ke makamnya, sebuah kuil didirikan. Di Fukukawa, Oga, Akita, kuil batu disebut "Seiryū-sama", dan Mizuki Shigeru memperkenalkannya sebagai dewa tangan dan kaki.
long_description.en: In Beppu a similar belief is called "手足荒神". According to its origin story, a samurai whose hands and feet were broken before the Battle of Ishigakibaru in 1600 promised that his spirit would help those who sprained their limbs; after people were healed upon visiting his burial place a shrine was built. At Fukukawa, Oga, Akita, a stone shrine is called "Seiryū-sama", and Mizuki Shigeru introduced it as a god of hands and feet.

long_description.id: Koran daerah melaporkan bahwa pada festival tahunan Kuil Kai di Kashima, yang dikenal sebagai "Ashite Kōjin-san", pengunjung datang memohon kesembuhan tangan dan kaki serta kemajuan olahraga.
long_description.en: A regional newspaper reports that at the annual festival of Kai Shrine in Kashima, known as "Ashite Kōjin-san", visitors came to pray for recovery of hands and feet and for improvement in sports.

claims.quote: 足手荒神（あしてこうじん）は、手足の神である。民間信仰を起源とし、手足の病気や怪我に悩む者がその快癒を祈願するもので、信仰の特徴として手型や足型を奉納することが見られる。

statement.id: Ashite Kōjin adalah dewa tangan dan kaki yang dipuja demi pemulihan cedera dan penyakit.
statement.en: Ashite Kōjin is a hand-and-foot deity worshipped for recovery from injury and illness.

claims.quote: 民間信仰を起源とし、手足の病気や怪我に悩む者がその快癒を祈願するもので、信仰の特徴として手型や足型を奉納することが見られる。中にはギプスや松葉杖などを奉納するものもある。

statement.id: Pemuja mempersembahkan model tangan atau kaki, kadang gips atau kruk.

claims.quote: 信仰される地域は、秋田県、福岡県、熊本県、大分県などで、四国に及んでいるとの報告もある。熊本県嘉島町の甲斐神社（中郡甲斐神社）、熊本県大津町の西鶴甲斐神社や、熊本県八代市の医王寺は、「足手荒神」と通称されている。

statement.id: Kepercayaan ini dilaporkan di Akita, Fukuoka, Kumamoto, dan Ōita, bahkan sampai Shikoku; Kuil Kai di Kashima, 西鶴甲斐神社 di Ōtsu, dan 医王寺 di Yatsushiro (Kumamoto) lazim disebut "Ashite Kōjin".

statement.id: Sebagian kuil menyamakan dewa itu dengan Shōmen Kongō.

claims.quote: 西巌殿寺の足手荒神はお鏡石という丸い霊石が信仰の対象で、大分県竹田市飛田川や熊本県小国町の足手荒神などはこの分霊で、信仰圏は大野郡、直入郡、さらに宇和海を渡り四国にまで及ぶとの報告もある。

statement.id: Di 西巌殿寺 (Kumamoto) objek pemujaan Ashite Kōjin adalah batu suci bulat bernama Okagami-ishi; Ashite Kōjin di Taketa (Ōita) dan Oguni (Kumamoto) disebut berasal dari pembagian rohnya, dan wilayah kepercayaannya dilaporkan sampai Shikoku.
statement.en: At 西巌殿寺 (Kumamoto) the object of veneration of Ashite Kōjin is a round sacred stone called Okagami-ishi; the Ashite Kōjin of Taketa (Ōita) and Oguni (Kumamoto) are said to be branch spirits from it, and its sphere of belief is reported to reach Shikoku.

claims.quote: 手足を負傷して死んだという武将・甲斐親英（宗立）を祀る熊本県嘉島町の甲斐神社は足手荒神の総本社と称し、熊本県和水町や菊池市下古閑集落の足手荒神、熊本県大津町の西鶴甲斐神社、荒尾市の府本甲斐神社、熊本県美里町の砥用甲斐神社（現在廃社）などは、この分霊を勧請したものという。

statement.id: Kuil Kai di Kashima (Kumamoto), yang memuja panglima 甲斐親英 (宗立) yang konon meninggal karena luka tangan dan kaki, menyebut dirinya kuil induk Ashite Kōjin; berbagai Ashite Kōjin lain di Kumamoto disebut sebagai pembagian rohnya (kanjō).
statement.en: Kai Shrine in Kashima (Kumamoto), which enshrines the warlord 甲斐親英 (宗立) said to have died of injuries to his hands and feet, calls itself the head shrine of Ashite Kōjin; other Ashite Kōjin in Kumamoto are said to be branch spirits (kanjō) from it.

claims.quote: 慶長5年（1600年）、九州の関ヶ原と言われる石垣原の戦い（黒田如水 対 大友義統）の前日の夜半、斥候中に崖から落ち、手足を骨折した黒田方の侍が大友の兵に捕らえられた。侍は、『手を挫かずば、お前共の手に掛かる者ではない。切って手柄にせよ。死して百年の後まで、魂はこの世にとどまり、手足を挫いた者を救うであろう』と言い残し斬首された。

statement.id: Di Beppu, kisah asal menyebut bahwa pada 1600, malam sebelum Pertempuran Ishigakibaru, seorang samurai pihak Kuroda yang jatuh dari tebing saat mengintai dan patah tangan-kakinya ditangkap tentara Ōtomo; sebelum dipenggal ia berkata bahwa rohnya akan tinggal di dunia ini sampai seratus tahun dan menolong orang yang terkilir tangan dan kakinya.
statement.en: In Beppu, an origin story says that in 1600, the night before the Battle of Ishigakibaru, a Kuroda-side samurai who fell from a cliff while scouting and broke his hands and feet was captured by Ōtomo soldiers; before being beheaded he said his spirit would remain in this world for a hundred years to help those who sprain their hands and feet.

statement.id: Menurut legenda itu, komandan Ōtomo 吉弘統幸 yang iba menguburnya dengan hormat; karena orang yang terkilir tangan atau kakinya sembuh secara ajaib setelah berziarah ke sana, sebuah kuil didirikan dan dipuja sebagai "Tehi Kōjin" (手足荒神).
statement.en: In that legend the Ōtomo commander 吉弘統幸, moved to pity, buried him with care; because people who had sprained their hands or feet were wondrously healed after visiting, a shrine was built and worshipped as "手足荒神".

short_description.id: Dalam uraian al-Qazwini, Bahamut adalah monster jauh di bawah bumi yang menopang struktur penyangganya.
short_description.en: In al-Qazwini’s account, Bahamut is a monster deep below the earth supporting its foundation.

long_description.id: Dalam uraian al-Qazwini, Bahamut adalah monster jauh di bawah bumi yang menopang struktur penyangganya. Bahamut membawa banteng kosmis di punggung dan berada di dalam air.
long_description.en: In al-Qazwini’s account, Bahamut is a monster deep below the earth supporting its foundation. Bahamut carries the cosmic bull on its back and remains suspended in water.

long_description.id: Balhut menjadi nama varian dalam sejumlah kosmografi. Kosmografi al-Qazwini memakai ejaan Bahamut. Ringkasan kosmografi Lane menempatkan ular raksasa Falak di bawah Bahamut. Sumber utama Islam untuk ringkasan Lane belum jelas.
long_description.en: Balhut is a variant name in some cosmographies. Al-Qazwini’s cosmography uses the spelling Bahamut. Lane’s cosmographic summary places the gigantic serpent Falak below Bahamut. The primary Islamic source for Lane’s summary is unclear.

long_description.id: Dalam kosmografi yang dikutip Lane, bumi ditopang malaikat raksasa. Malaikat itu berdiri di atas batu rubi, batu itu di atas banteng raksasa, dan banteng itu di atas ikan yang sangat besar bernama Bahamoot. Di bawah ikan itu Tuhan menaruh air dan kegelapan, dan manusia tidak mengetahui apa yang ada di bawahnya.
long_description.en: In the cosmography quoted by Lane, the earth is held up by a giant angel. The angel stands on a ruby rock, the rock on a huge bull, and the bull on an enormous fish named Bahamoot. Beneath the fish God placed water and darkness, and people do not know what lies below.

long_description.id: Sumber-sumber berbeda tentang apa sebenarnya Bahamut. Uraian terjemahan Lane menyebutnya ikan, sedangkan tafsir yang menjelaskan huruf Nun memberi nama itu kepada banteng dan menyebut paus bernama Liwash. Menurut sebuah kisah dari Yakut, Iblis hampir membuat Balhut menimbulkan gempa, tetapi Tuhan mengalihkannya dengan mengirim agas ke matanya. Menurut teks Lane, banyak orang Arab mengaitkan gempa dengan banteng itu.
long_description.en: Sources differ on what Bahamut actually is. The account in Lane's text calls it a fish, while the commentary explaining the letter Nun gives the name to the bull and calls the whale Liwash. In a report from Yakut, Iblis nearly got Balhut to cause a quake, but God turned its attention away by sending gnats at its eyes. Many of the Arabs attribute earthquakes to the bull.

literal_meaning.id: Nama Bahamut diperkirakan berasal dari Behemoth dalam Alkitab; dalam teks yang diterjemahkan, ikan itu ditulis Bahamoot [Behemoth].
literal_meaning.en: The name Bahamut is thought to derive from the biblical Behemoth; in the translated text the fish is given as Bahamoot [Behemoth].

short_description.id: Kucing kaktus adalah "fearsome critter" legendaris dari American Southwest: makhluk mirip bobcat berduri yang menyayat kaktus pada malam hari dan meminum getahnya yang telah berfermentasi.
short_description.en: A legendary "fearsome critter" from the American Southwest, the cactus cat is a thorny, bobcat-like creature that cuts into cacti by night and later drinks their fermented juice.

long_description.id: Kucing kaktus adalah "fearsome critter" legendaris dari American Southwest. Biasanya digambarkan sebagai makhluk mirip bobcat yang tertutup duri seperti rambut, dengan duri yang sangat panjang pada kaki serta ekornya yang bercabang dan berlapis baja.
long_description.en: Among the "fearsome critters" of the American Southwest is the cactus cat. It was usually pictured as resembling a bobcat, clad in hair-like thorns, with notably long spines on its legs and a branching, armored tail.

long_description.id: Dalam bukunya, Cox menulis bahwa kucing kaktus berambut berduri, duri pada telinganya panjang dan kaku, ekornya bercabang, dan pada lengan bawahnya terdapat bilah tulang tajam. Menurut Cox, hanya para penghuni lama yang mengetahui hewan ini dan kebiasaannya yang aneh. Ia hidup di daerah-daerah kaktus yang luas, terutama banyak di antara Prescott dan Tucson, dan juga dilaporkan dari lembah Yaqui bagian bawah di Meksiko Lama serta perbukitan Yucatan.
long_description.en: In his book Cox wrote that the cactus cat has thorny hair, with long, rigid thorns on its ears, a branched tail, and sharp blades of bone on its forearms. Cox remarks that just the old-timers are acquainted with the creature and its odd habits. It lives in the great cactus districts, especially abundant between Prescott and Tucson, and has also been reported from the lower Yaqui valley in Old Mexico and the hills of Yucatan.

long_description.id: Makhluk ini konon menggunakan durinya untuk menyayat kaktus pada malam hari sehingga getahnya mengalir. Menurut Cox, hal itu dilakukan secara sistematis pada banyak pohon selama beberapa malam. Pada malam-malam berikutnya ia kembali meminum getah yang sudah berfermentasi; menurut Cox, ia lalu mabuk berat, berdansa di bawah cahaya bulan, menggesekkan lengan bawahnya, dan menjerit kegirangan.
long_description.en: Legend held that it used its spines to cut cacti at night so their juice flowed. Cox says it does this methodically to many trees over several nights. On later nights it comes back to drink the fermented juice; Cox adds that it then gets thoroughly drunk, waltzes off in the moonlight, rubs its forearms together and screams with delight.

long_description.id: Cox menyebut bahwa hampir setiap daerah penebangan kayu memiliki kabar samar tentang binatang menakutkan yang diceritakan kepada pendatang baru, dan bahwa tujuan bukunya adalah melestarikan deskripsi dan sketsa hewan-hewan yang diciptakan para penebang kayu.
long_description.en: Cox notes that nearly every lumber district has vague rumors of dreadful beasts told to newcomers, and that the purpose of his book is to preserve descriptions and sketches of the animals the lumberjacks originated.

short_description.id: Chamunda adalah wujud ganas Chandi atau Mahadevi dan anggota tujuh Matrika.
short_description.en: Chamunda is a fierce form of Chandi or Mahadevi and a member of the seven Matrikas.

long_description.id: Chamunda adalah wujud ganas Chandi atau Mahadevi dan anggota tujuh Matrika. Ia juga salah satu Yogini yang mengiringi Parvati.
long_description.en: Chamunda is a fierce form of Chandi or Mahadevi and a member of the seven Matrikas. She is also one of the Yoginis attending Parvati.

long_description.id: Namanya menggabungkan nama Chanda dan Munda, dua demon yang dibunuhnya. Ia sering digambarkan tinggal di tempat pembakaran jenazah atau dekat pohon ara suci. Penggambaran belakangan memperlihatkannya sebagai perempuan tua menyerupai kerangka dengan mata cekung. Ia digambarkan berdiri atau duduk di atas jasad atau demon yang dikalahkan.
long_description.en: Her name combines Chanda and Munda, two demons she kills. She is often depicted living in cremation grounds or near sacred fig trees. Later depictions show her as a skeletal old woman with sunken eyes. She is depicted standing or sitting on a corpse or a vanquished demon.

long_description.id: Dalam Devi-Mahatmya menurut terjemahan Pargiter, Kali yang berwajah mengerikan keluar dari dahi Ambika yang murka, dengan kalung tengkorak, kulit harimau, tubuh kurus, mulut lebar, dan mata merah cekung. Ia melahap pasukan para Asura, memenggal Caṇḍa dan merobohkan Muṇḍa, lalu Caṇḍikā menyatakan ia akan termasyhur dengan nama Cāmuṇḍā. Sumber lain menyebut ia muncul dari tengah alis Kaushiki atau dari kerutan dahi Parvati, dan Devi Mahatmya menyamakannya dengan Kali sedangkan Varaha Purana menyebut keduanya terpisah.
long_description.en: In the Devi-Mahatmya as translated by Pargiter, Kali of the terrible countenance issues from the forehead of the wrathful Ambika, with a garland of skulls, a tiger's skin, emaciated flesh, a wide mouth and deep-sunk reddish eyes. She devours the Asura host, strikes off Caṇḍa's head and fells Muṇḍa, and Caṇḍikā declares she shall be famed by the name Cāmuṇḍā. Other sources say she emerged from between Kaushiki's eyebrows or from Parvati's frown, and the Devi Mahatmya identifies her with Kali while the Varaha Purana names them as separate goddesses.

long_description.id: Chamunda adalah satu dari Matrika, dewi ibu yang menakutkan, penculik dan pemakan anak, lambang wabah dan penyakit masa kanak-kanak. Ia satu-satunya Matrika yang merupakan Shakti Dewi agung dan satu-satunya yang menikmati pemujaan mandiri. Meminum darah adalah ciri semua Matrika, terutama Chamunda, dan menurut Matsya Purana ia bersama para matrika lain diciptakan Shiva untuk membantunya membunuh Andhakasura. Ramakrishna Gopal Bhandarkar berpendapat ia semula dewi suku di pegunungan Vindhya.
long_description.en: Chamunda is one of the Matrikas, fearsome mother goddesses, abductors and eaters of children, emblematic of childhood pestilence and disease. Among the Matrikas she alone is the Shakti of the great Goddess Devi, and she alone is worshipped independently. Drinking blood is a characteristic of all the Matrikas, and of Chamunda in particular, and in the Matsya Purana Shiva creates her together with the other matrikas as helpers in killing Andhakasura. Ramakrishna Gopal Bhandarkar claims she was originally a tribal goddess of the Vindhya mountains.

cultural_context.id: Ciri-ciri ikonografinya yang menakutkan, kontras dengan penggambaran dewi Hindu pada umumnya yang berwajah cantik, melambangkan tak terelakkannya usia tua, kematian, pembusukan, dan kehancuran. Para Matrika sendiri disebut lambang wabah, demam, kelaparan, dan penyakit pada masa kanak-kanak.
cultural_context.en: Her terrifying iconography, in contrast to typical depictions of Hindu goddesses with beautiful faces, symbolises the inevitability of old age, death, decay and destruction. The Matrikas themselves are said to be emblematic of childhood pestilence, fever, starvation and disease.

short_description.id: Naga (drakōn) berperan penting dalam mitologi Yunani dan menjadi asal kata "dragon"; umumnya ular besar yang lebih dikaitkan dengan ludah atau napas beracun.
short_description.en: Dragons (drakōn) play a significant role in Greek mythology and are the origin of the word "dragon"; they were generally large snakes tied more to poisonous spit or breath.

long_description.id: Naga berperan penting dalam mitologi Yunani. Drakōn Yunani sering berbeda dari naga Barat modern, tetapi menjadi asal istilah modern itu. Orang Yunani kuno memakai istilah tersebut untuk ular besar pembelit, dan drakōn jauh lebih dikaitkan dengan ludah atau napas beracun, meskipun napas berapi masih tercatat dalam beberapa mitos.
long_description.en: Dragons play a significant role in Greek mythology. The Greek drakōn often differs from the modern Western dragon but is the origin of the modern term. Ancient Greeks applied the word to large constricting snakes, and the drakōn was far more tied to poisonous spit or breath, though fiery breath is still attested in a few myths.

long_description.id: Ada pula drakaina, bentuk betinanya, yang sering selamat dengan kawin dengan pahlawan atau menjadi leluhur garis keturunan penting. Delphyne, yang dalam beberapa mitos disebut sebagai naga itu, sering digambarkan setengah gadis dan setengah ular.
long_description.en: There is also the drakaina, the female form, which often survives by mating with a hero or by being the ancestress of an important lineage. Delphyne, the name some myths give the dragon, was often pictured as half girl and half snake.

long_description.id: Contoh yang terkenal adalah Ladon, ular berkepala seratus penjaga apel emas para Hesperides yang dibunuh Herakles, dan naga Kolkhis yang menjaga Bulu Domba Emas di hutan suci Ares. Naga Kolkhis itu dibunuh sang pahlawan atau ditidurkan Medea, dan dalam Pythian Ode 4 Pindar melukiskannya jauh melampaui panjang dan lebar kapal berdayung lima puluh.
long_description.en: Famous examples are Ladon, the hundred-headed serpent guarding the golden apples of the Hesperides, slain by Herakles, and the Colchian dragon that guarded the Golden Fleece in the sacred grove of Ares. The Colchian dragon was either slain by the hero or put to sleep by Medea, and in Pindar's Pythian Ode 4 it far surpasses in length and breadth a ship of fifty oars.

short_description.id: Gogfran Gawr adalah raksasa dalam tradisi Wales yang dikenal sebagai ayah Gwenhwyfar, istri Arthur, dan dikaitkan dengan Powys serta Brycheiniog.
short_description.en: Gogfran Gawr is a giant of Welsh tradition known as the father of Gwenhwyfar, wife of Arthur, and linked with Powys and Brycheiniog.

long_description.id: Menurut sebagian tradisi Wales, raksasa Gogfran Gawr adalah ayah Gwenhwyfar, istri Arthur. Dalam salah satu Triad Wales disebut tiga Gwenhwyfar yang menikah dengan Arthur, dan yang ketiga adalah putri (G)og(y)rfan Gawr; dalam varian Triad lain hanya putri Gogfran Gawr yang disebut. Teks-teks Welsh Tengah juga menyebut raksasa Ogyruan atau Gogyrfan sebagai ayahnya. Adaptasi Wales atas karya Geoffrey, seperti Brut y Brenhinedd, juga menjadikannya putri raksasa Og[y]vran, dan penyair abad ke-14 Dafydd ap Gwilym menyebutnya putri Ogfran sang raksasa.
long_description.en: According to some Welsh traditions, the giant Gogfran Gawr was the father of Gwenhwyfar, wife of Arthur. One Welsh Triad names three Gwenhwyfars married to Arthur, the third being the daughter of (G)og(y)rfan Gawr; a variant of another Triad mentions only the daughter of Gogfran Gawr. Middle Welsh texts likewise name the giant Ogyruan or Gogyrfan as her father. Welsh versions of Geoffrey's history, such as Brut y Brenhinedd, also make her the giant Og[y]vran's daughter, and the 14th-century poet Dafydd ap Gwilym calls her the daughter of Ogfran the Giant.

long_description.id: Bentuk namanya beragam: Gogfran paling umum, tetapi ada juga Ogfran, Gogrfran, Gogyrfan, dan Ogrfan. Para penyair cywydd memahami unsur -fran sebagai brân (gagak), sedangkan nama sungai Ogran di Sir Fynwy memunculkan dugaan bahwa ogr- berarti tajam.
long_description.en: His name varies: Gogfran is most common, but Ogfran, Gogrfran, Gogyrfan and Ogrfan also occur. The cywydd poets understood the element -fran as brân (crow), while the stream name Ogran in Sir Fynwy has led to the suggestion that ogr- means sharp.

long_description.id: Raksasa ini dikaitkan dengan Powys dan Brycheiniog. Siôn Dafydd Rhys, dalam daftar raksasa yang disusun sekitar tahun 1600, menyebut Gogfran Gawr tinggal di Aber Ysgyr, di benteng di atas sungai dekat Aber Hodni (Aberhonddu). Daftar yang sama mengisahkan saudara-saudara Gwenhwyfar yang dipenjara raksasa lain dan diselamatkan Arthur.
long_description.en: The giant is linked with Powys and Brycheiniog. Siôn Dafydd Rhys, in a list of giants compiled around 1600, says Gogfran Gawr lived at Aber Ysgyr in the caer above the river near Aber Hodni (Aberhonddu). The same list tells of Gwenhwyfar's brothers, imprisoned by other giants and rescued by Arthur.

long_description.id: Rachel Bromwich berpendapat bahwa Og(y)rfan yang disebut dalam kaitan dengan Powys adalah seorang pahlawan awal, sehingga tradisinya tampak mencampur dua tokoh: pahlawan dari Powys dan raksasa ayah Gwenhwyfar. Nama Caer Ogyrfan pernah dipakai untuk benteng bukit Hen Ddinas dekat Croesoswallt.
long_description.en: Rachel Bromwich suggests that the Og(y)rfan linked with Powys was an early hero, so the tradition seems to mix two figures: a hero of Powys and the giant father of Gwenhwyfar. The name Caer Ogyrfan was once used for the hillfort Hen Ddinas near Croesoswallt.

short_description.id: Heluo fish adalah ikan mitologis Tiongkok dengan satu kepala dan sepuluh tubuh.
short_description.en: Heluo fish is a Chinese mythological fish with one head and ten bodies.

long_description.id: Heluo adalah ikan dalam mitologi Tiongkok yang berkepala satu dan bertubuh sepuluh, bersama ikan zi. Shanhaijing menempatkannya di air Gunung Qiaoming (Mount Burnbright dalam terjemahan Inggris).
long_description.en: The heluo fish is a fish of Chinese mythology with one head and ten bodies, together with the Zi fish. The Shanhaijing places it in the waters of Mount Qiaoming (Mount Burnbright in the English translation).

long_description.id: Ikan ini bersuara seperti anjing menyalak dan memakannya disebut menyembuhkan bisul. Ikan zi digambarkan juga berkepala satu dan bertubuh sepuluh tetapi berbau seperti tanaman wangi.
long_description.en: The fish makes a sound like a barking dog and eating it is said to cure carbuncles. The Zi fish is described as also having one head and ten bodies but smelling like the scent-herb.

long_description.id: Yiyu Tuzan, yang dikutip dalam catatan Wu Renchen dan dibahas Wikipedia, menyebut ikan heluo dapat berubah menjadi burung xiujiu yang mencuri beras tumbuk dan jatuh mati ke lesung. Catatan yang sama memuat keterangan Yang Shen bahwa ikan heluo kini adalah 'ikan delapan sabuk'.
long_description.en: The Yiyu Tuzan, quoted in Wu Renchen's notes and discussed on Wikipedia, says the heluo fish can turn into the xiujiu bird, which steals husked rice and falls dead into the mortar. The same notes record Yang Shen's remark that the heluo fish is now the 'eight-band fish'.

description.id: Menurut Shanhaijing, memakan ikan heluo menyembuhkan bisul; artikel Wikipedia menerjemahkannya sebagai tumor ganas.
description.en: According to the Shanhaijing, eating the heluo fish cures carbuncles; the Wikipedia article renders this as cancerous growths.
