short_description.id: 人面魚 adalah nama dua varian makhluk ikan berwajah manusia dalam cerita dan legenda urban Taiwan.
short_description.en: 人面魚 names two fish-being variants in Taiwanese folklore and urban legends.

long_description.id: 人面魚 adalah nama dua varian makhluk ikan berwajah manusia dalam cerita dan legenda urban Taiwan. Varian tradisional memiliki tubuh ikan besar dengan wajah manusia dan tertawa saat melihat orang. Kisah urban tentang ikan bakar yang berbicara menyebar luas melalui laporan 1995.
long_description.en: 人面魚 names two fish-being variants in Taiwanese folklore and urban legends. The traditional variant has a large fish body with a human face and laughs on seeing people. An urban tale of a speaking grilled fish spread widely through a 1995 report.

long_description.id: Menurut artikel PanSci, legenda urban 人面魚 berkisah tentang pemancing yang memanggang ikan nila besar dan mendengar suara perempuan tua berbahasa Taiwan bertanya apakah dagingnya enak; ikan itu membuka-tutup mulut dengan wajah perempuan tua pada tubuhnya, dan dalam kisah itu orang yang memancingnya meninggal keesokan harinya. Legenda ini punya banyak varian dalam lokasi, tanggal foto, dan jumlah orang.
long_description.en: According to the PanSci article, the urban legend of the 人面魚 tells of anglers who grill a large tilapia and hear an old woman's voice in Taiwanese asking whether the meat is tasty; the fish opens and closes its mouth with an old woman's face on its body, and in the story the person who caught it dies the next day. The legend has many variants in location, photo date and number of people.

long_description.id: Artikel itu mencatat legenda ini memukul usaha ikan budidaya dan sebagian orang mengatakan penerima foto harus menyalinnya untuk menolak bencana. Ia juga mengutip legenda siluman ikan di Waduk Lantan dan penjelasan penulis bahwa wajah itu hanyalah hasil kepekaan otak manusia terhadap wajah.
long_description.en: The article records that the legend hurt the fish-farming trade and that some said recipients of the photo must copy it to ward off misfortune. It also cites the fish-spirit legend of Lantan and the authors' explanation that the face is merely a product of the human brain's sensitivity to faces.

sources.author: 臺北地方異聞工作室 (Taipei Legend studio)

claims.quote: 人面魚，是台湾民間傳說和都市传说中的妖怪，兩種同名但外貌相異，也都和日本的人面魚不同。

statement.id: 人面魚 adalah nama dua varian makhluk ikan berwajah manusia dalam cerita dan legenda urban Taiwan.
statement.en: 人面魚 names two fish-being variants in Taiwanese folklore and urban legends.

claims.quote: 人面魚是人臉魚身的水棲妖怪，又名「淵魚」、「海童」，身軀為大魚，但卻擁有人面雙眼口鼻的臉龐，型態詭異萬分。若人面魚浮立於水面，只要見到人，就會開口呵呵嘻笑，甚至以魚鰭做合掌的模樣。

statement.id: Varian tradisional memiliki tubuh ikan besar dengan wajah manusia dan tertawa saat melihat orang.
statement.en: The traditional variant has a large fish body with a human face and laughs on seeing people.

claims.quote: 在1990年代初開始出現，於1995年經自由時報刊出的地方軼聞而廣泛流傳，大意描述有民眾至高雄縣岡山鎮（今高雄市岡山區）的溪裡（另一說為嘉義市蘭潭）出遊釣起一尾吳郭魚，燒烤欲食用時卻聽到用閩南語詭異的聲音詢問：「魚肉好吃否？」之後其拍攝的照片魚的上頭還浮現人臉，令當事人毛骨悚然。其後台視玫瑰之夜鬼話連篇曾以此題材製播節目，並展示出所謂的「靈異照片」。2018年，根據此傳說改拍成電影《紅衣小女孩》的外傳:《人面魚：紅衣小女孩外傳》。

statement.id: Kisah urban tentang ikan bakar yang berbicara menyebar luas melalui laporan 1995.
statement.en: An urban tale of a speaking grilled fish spread widely through a 1995 report.

claims.quote: 某天一群人到溪邊釣魚，其中有人釣到了一條巨大的吳郭魚，眾人立刻將其烤食。當大家吃喝得正高興，忽然聽見一個蒼老的女聲，操著台語問：「魚肉好吃否？」
claims.locator: Artikel PanSci tentang legenda urban 人面魚

statement.id: Menurut artikel PanSci, legenda urban 人面魚 berkisah tentang sekelompok orang memancing di tepi sungai dan memanggang seekor ikan nila besar, lalu tiba-tiba terdengar suara perempuan tua berbahasa Taiwan (台語) yang bertanya, 'Apakah daging ikan ini enak?' (魚肉好吃否？).
statement.en: According to the PanSci article, the urban legend of the 人面魚 tells of a group fishing by a stream and grilling a large tilapia, when an old woman's voice speaking Taiwanese (台語) suddenly asks, 'Is the fish meat tasty?' (魚肉好吃否？).

claims.quote: 大家四處尋找聲音的來源，直到聽到第二次問句，才發現竟然是被烤熟的吳郭魚一張一合地開口說話，仔細一看，魚身上還浮現一名老太婆的臉。其中三人當場嘔吐，一人拿相機將魚拍了下來，到了隔天，釣起那條魚的人在睡夢中死去，死因不明。
claims.locator: Artikel PanSci tentang legenda urban 人面魚

statement.id: Dalam kisah itu, ikan panggang tersebut ternyata membuka-tutup mulutnya dan wajah seorang perempuan tua tampak pada tubuhnya; tiga orang langsung muntah, seorang memotret ikan itu, dan keesokan harinya orang yang memancing ikan tersebut meninggal dalam tidurnya dengan sebab tak jelas.
statement.en: In the story, the grilled tilapia was found to be opening and closing its mouth with an old woman's face on its body; three people vomited on the spot, one took a photo of the fish, and the next day the person who caught it died in his sleep of unknown cause.

claims.quote: 這則傳說的變體非常多，故事的梗概雖然大致相同，細節卻有許多差異。比如事發地點，有的說是高雄岡山，有的說是嘉義蘭潭，也有說是台南、屏東的；照片拍攝時間，從1994年12月到1995年7月都有；參與人數也有3人、4人、6人、8人的版本
claims.locator: Artikel PanSci tentang legenda urban 人面魚

statement.id: Artikel itu menyebut legenda ini punya banyak varian dengan inti serupa tetapi detail berbeda: lokasinya disebut Gangshan di Kaohsiung (高雄岡山), Lantan di Chiayi (嘉義蘭潭), atau Tainan dan Pingtung; waktu foto dari Desember 1994 sampai Juli 1995; dan jumlah orang 3, 4, 6, atau 8.
statement.en: The article says the legend has very many variants with the same outline but differing details: the place is given as Gangshan in Kaohsiung (高雄岡山), Lantan in Chiayi (嘉義蘭潭), or Tainan and Pingtung; the photo date ranges from December 1994 to July 1995; and the number of people is 3, 4, 6 or 8.

claims.quote: 當時因為人面魚的傳說，養殖魚業的生意一落千丈，吳郭魚每公斤價格從45元掉到35元，就連釣魚場生意也變得冷冷清清。
claims.locator: Artikel PanSci tentang legenda urban 人面魚

statement.id: Menurut artikel itu, akibat legenda ini usaha ikan budidaya anjlok: harga ikan nila per kilogram turun dari 45 menjadi 35 dan usaha pemancingan pun sepi.
statement.en: According to the article, because of the legend the fish-farming trade plunged: the price of tilapia per kilogram dropped from 45 to 35 and fishing-pond businesses grew quiet.

claims.quote: 節目當中靈學老師提到，有許多人將人面魚照片寄給他，並且告訴他人面魚的故事（雖然版本各不相同）。其中有人告訴他，「拿到這張照片，一定要拷貝一張送出去，這樣才能夠消災解厄。」
claims.locator: Artikel PanSci tentang legenda urban 人面魚

statement.id: Artikel itu mengutip seorang ahli ilmu gaib dalam acara televisi Guihua Lianpian (鬼話連篇) bahwa banyak orang mengirimkan foto 人面魚 kepadanya dan sebagian mengatakan bahwa orang yang menerima foto itu harus menyalin dan mengirimkannya agar terhindar dari bencana (消災解厄).
statement.en: The article quotes a parapsychology teacher on the television programme Guihua Lianpian (鬼話連篇) that many people mailed him the 人面魚 photograph, and some told him that whoever receives the photo must copy and send it on to ward off misfortune (消災解厄).

claims.quote: 傳說蘭潭內住著一隻大魚精，每當他的魚兵魚將被釣客抓走，就會抓一條人命來賠，因此每釣起一隻大魚，就會發生一起溺水事件，這被稱為「蘭潭抓交替」。
claims.locator: Artikel PanSci tentang legenda urban 人面魚

statement.id: Artikel itu mencatat legenda 魚精 (siluman ikan) di Waduk Lantan (蘭潭) di Chiayi: konon seekor siluman ikan besar mengambil satu nyawa sebagai ganti tiap kali anak buahnya ditangkap pemancing, sehingga tiap ikan besar yang ditangkap diikuti satu kejadian tenggelam, yang disebut 蘭潭抓交替.
statement.en: The article records a 魚精 (fish-spirit) legend at Lantan (蘭潭) in Chiayi: a great fish spirit is said to take a human life in return whenever its fish soldiers are caught by anglers, so each large fish caught is followed by a drowning, called 蘭潭抓交替.

claims.quote: 只要有一些輪廓，我們對人臉過度敏感的大腦，就可以把它看成一張臉。
claims.locator: Artikel PanSci tentang legenda urban 人面魚

statement.id: Penulis artikel menjelaskan bahwa otak manusia yang sangat peka terhadap wajah dapat menganggap pola yang hanya memiliki sedikit kontur sebagai sebuah wajah, dan menyimpulkan bahwa 人面魚 hanyalah kebetulan hasil kepekaan otak terhadap wajah.
statement.en: The article's authors explain that the human brain, being oversensitive to faces, can see a face in any image with some outline, and conclude that the 人面魚 is merely a coincidence from the brain's sensitivity to faces.

short_description.id: Wind Horse adalah gambaran kuda terbang yang melambangkan jiwa dalam tradisi Asia Timur dan Tengah.
short_description.en: Wind Horse is a flying-horse image symbolizing the soul in East and Central Asian traditions.

long_description.id: Wind Horse adalah gambaran kuda terbang yang melambangkan jiwa dalam tradisi Asia Timur dan Tengah. Dalam Buddhisme Tibet, kuda ini juga menjadi lambang kesejahteraan dan keberuntungan.
long_description.en: Wind Horse is a flying-horse image symbolizing the soul in East and Central Asian traditions. In Tibetan Buddhism, the horse also symbolizes well-being and good fortune.

long_description.id: Karmay menjelaskan bahwa Wind Horse terutama merupakan unsur budaya rakyat Tibet. Istilah Wind Horse mengacu pada keberuntungan, selain bendera yang dipasang di tempat tinggi.
long_description.en: Karmay explains that Wind Horse is predominantly an element of Tibetan folk culture. The term Wind Horse denotes good fortune beyond the flags placed in high locations.

long_description.id: Menurut Clarke Warren, lungta adalah kata Tibet untuk windhorse dan memiliki banyak tingkat makna, dari agama rakyat hingga kerohanian terdalam. Bendera doa sendiri disebut lungta dan diberi gambar windhorse yang ditemani empat hewan lain di arah mata angin. Ia menambahkan bahwa penjelasan populer tentang keberuntungan dianggapnya dangkal, dan bahwa Samten Karmay menelusuri kemungkinan akar windhorse ke Tiongkok dan India.
long_description.en: According to Clarke Warren, lungta is Tibetan for windhorse and carries many levels of meaning, from folk religion to the deepest spirituality. The prayer flags themselves are called lungta and are inscribed with the windhorse accompanied by four other animals in the cardinal directions. He adds that he finds the popular explanation of luck shallow, and that Samten Karmay traces windhorse's possible roots to China and India.

cultural_context.id: Menurut Warren, seseorang dikatakan memiliki lungta yang "naik" atau "turun" sesuai keselarasannya dengan tubuh, pikiran, dan lingkungannya, sehingga lungta juga berfungsi melindungi bila berhasil diundang.
cultural_context.en: According to Warren, a person is said to have lungta that is "up" or "down" depending on their synchronization with body, mind and surroundings, so lungta also serves a protective function when successfully invoked.

note.id: Garuda termasuk empat hewan yang menemani windhorse di bendera doa.
note.en: Garuda is one of the four animals accompanying the windhorse on the prayer flag.

sources.title: Riding on the Wind: The Culture of Windhorse
sources.author: Clarke Warren
sources.publisher: The Chronicles of Chögyam Trungpa Rinpoche (chronicleproject.com)

claims.quote: The wind horse is a flying horse that is the symbol of the human soul in the shamanistic tradition of East Asia and Central Asia. In Tibetan Buddhism, it was included as the pivotal element in the center of the four animals symbolizing the cardinal directions and a symbol of the idea of well-being or good fortune.

statement.id: Wind Horse adalah gambaran kuda terbang yang melambangkan jiwa dalam tradisi Asia Timur dan Tengah.
statement.en: Wind Horse is a flying-horse image symbolizing the soul in East and Central Asian traditions.

claims.quote: The wind horse is a flying horse that is the symbol of the human soul in the shamanistic tradition of East Asia and Central Asia. In Tibetan Buddhism, it was included as the pivotal element in the center of the four animals symbolizing the cardinal directions and a symbol of the idea of well-being or good fortune.

statement.id: Dalam Buddhisme Tibet, kuda ini juga menjadi lambang kesejahteraan dan keberuntungan.
statement.en: In Tibetan Buddhism, the horse also symbolizes well-being and good fortune.

claims.quote: Windhorse was predominantly a feature of the folk culture, a "mundane notion of the layman rather than a Buddhist religious ideal," as Tibetan scholar Samten G. Karmay explains.

statement.id: Karmay menjelaskan bahwa Wind Horse terutama merupakan unsur budaya rakyat Tibet.
statement.en: Karmay explains that Wind Horse is predominantly an element of Tibetan folk culture.

claims.quote: Windhorse has several meanings in the Tibetan context. As Karmay notes, "the word [windhorse] is still and often mistakenly taken to mean only the actual flag planted on the roof of a house or on a high place near a village. In fact, it is a symbol of the idea of well-being or good fortune.

statement.id: Istilah Wind Horse mengacu pada keberuntungan, selain bendera yang dipasang di tempat tinggi.
statement.en: The term Wind Horse denotes good fortune beyond the flags placed in high locations.

claims.quote: Lungta is Tibetan for windhorse. It is a designation which carries a number of levels of significance, from the popular expression of folk religion to the deepest levels of spirituality, and it links the two. It holds a prominent place in Tibetan religious and folk culture, and has its equivalents in many other cultures.

statement.id: Menurut Clarke Warren, lungta adalah kata Tibet untuk windhorse; sebutan itu mengandung banyak tingkat makna, dari ungkapan agama rakyat hingga tingkat kerohanian terdalam, dan menghubungkan keduanya. Ia menempati kedudukan penting dalam budaya religius dan rakyat Tibet serta memiliki padanan di banyak budaya lain.
statement.en: According to Clarke Warren, lungta is Tibetan for windhorse; the term carries many levels of significance, from the popular expression of folk religion to the deepest levels of spirituality, and links the two. It holds a prominent place in Tibetan religious and folk culture and has equivalents in many other cultures.

claims.quote: the prayer flags themselves are referred to as lungta, and are inscribed with drawings of the windhorse, accompanied in the cardinal directions by four other animals, each with its own symbolic significance (Tiger, Lion or Yak, Garuda, Dragon).

statement.id: Warren menyebut bahwa bendera doa sendiri disebut lungta dan diberi gambar windhorse, yang di arah mata angin ditemani empat hewan lain, masing-masing bermakna simbolis (Harimau, Singa atau Yak, Garuda, Naga).
statement.en: Warren notes that the prayer flags themselves are called lungta and are inscribed with drawings of the windhorse, accompanied in the cardinal directions by four other animals, each with its own symbolic significance (Tiger, Lion or Yak, Garuda, Dragon).

claims.quote: The popular explanation of lungta is that it refers to “good fortune” or “luck”. Surprisingly, a fair amount of the academic literature on Tibetan culture stops at this (with notable exceptions). But “luck” is a shallow sense of lungta. Windhorse refers to something much more basic and vital than mere “luck”, at least in the Western sense of the word.

statement.id: Warren menulis bahwa penjelasan populer menyebut lungta berarti "keberuntungan" atau "nasib baik", tetapi menurutnya "keberuntungan" hanyalah makna yang dangkal; windhorse merujuk pada sesuatu yang jauh lebih mendasar dan vital daripada sekadar "keberuntungan" dalam pengertian Barat.
statement.en: Warren writes that the popular explanation of lungta is "good fortune" or "luck", but he calls "luck" a shallow sense; windhorse refers to something much more basic and vital than mere "luck" in the Western sense of the word.

claims.quote: Samten Karmay, in an excellent brief paper on the origins of windhorse, entitled Windhorse and the Well-being of Man*, traces its possible roots to China, on one hand, (where it may have been confounded with “river-horse”, another potent image and principle) and to India in another later, more Buddhist context.

statement.id: Warren menyebut bahwa Samten Karmay, dalam makalah singkat berjudul Windhorse and the Well-being of Man, menelusuri kemungkinan akar windhorse ke Tiongkok (tempat ia mungkin tertukar dengan "kuda sungai") dan, pada konteks yang lebih belakangan dan lebih Buddhis, ke India.
statement.en: Warren says that Samten Karmay, in a brief paper titled Windhorse and the Well-being of Man, traces windhorse's possible roots to China (where it may have been confounded with "river-horse") and, in a later and more Buddhist context, to India.

claims.quote: A person’s lungta is a register of their relative synchronization with their own body and mind, and the world around them. So in this regard, lungta also has a protective function when successfully invoked.

statement.id: Warren menulis bahwa lungta seseorang mencerminkan keselarasannya dengan tubuh, pikiran, dan dunia di sekitarnya, sehingga lungta juga memiliki fungsi pelindung bila berhasil diundang.
statement.en: Warren writes that a person's lungta registers their relative synchronization with their own body and mind and the world around them, so lungta also has a protective function when successfully invoked.

selection_criteria: computeFillStatus must be lengkap-informasi: complete, valid research without an approved image.
No active editorial artwork and no permanent artwork exclusion.
The accepted research entry is embedded unchanged; the image may only depict what its claims document.
Creatures an earlier batch left out keep that reason as catatan_sebelumnya; the generator may decline them with status tidak-digambar.

user_policy.name: sangar
user_policy.intent: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
user_policy.subject: The being dominates the frame and is clearly the subject. Head, eyes and distinguishing traits are readable even at thumbnail size. Never a landscape without the being, never a human who could be a passer-by, never a farm animal at pasture.
user_policy.moment: Depict a moment, not a pose: hunting, emerging, striking, commanding, towering, descending, tearing through weather or ground. Gaze and posture confront or loom over the viewer. Standing still and facing the camera with a neutral expression is not acceptable.
user_policy.effects: Visible power is wanted and may be strong, but every effect must come from a power, domain, attribute, habitat or deed documented in the research claims of that being, and it must act physically on the world: ground cracking, water rearing, trees bending, lightning striking, flame consuming, fog pouring, bodies of victims turned to stone. No generic glowing envelope, neon outline, energy ribbons, floating runes or luminous coloured mist. If the research documents no power, build menace from anatomy, scale, moment, light and setting instead, and record that in artistic_choices.
user_policy.fidelity: Anatomy, attributes, number of heads, eyes, limbs and iconography follow the research claims exactly. Effects and atmosphere add power; they never replace or invent anatomy. Fully opaque clothing where a humanlike form is clothed; no nudity, no explicit gore.
user_policy.composition: Low camera angle; monumental or predatory scale with small environmental references when size is documented, otherwise dominance through tight framing and foreshortening. Strong silhouette, high contrast, cinematic low-key lighting from one dominant source (moon, fire, lightning, dying sun), rim light, dust, smoke, rain or spray. Tactile surfaces: wet scales, matted fur, cracked skin, rust, weathered cloth, stone.
user_policy.setting: The place its stories name: graveyard, swamp, sea cliff, battlefield, celestial palace, desert storm. Weather and time of day heighten threat or majesty. Palette is dark and warm with one strong accent, consistent with the collection; no pastel, no flat even daylight.
user_policy.respect: Living religions (Hindu, Buddhist, Shinto, Abrahamic and folk deities still worshipped) are majestic and overwhelming rather than monstrous: cosmic scale, divine radiance from documented attributes, the elements they rule in motion. Malevolent beings are menacing. Literary beings follow their source text, never a film, game, anime or comic design.
user_policy.aniconic: If the research documents no bodily form at all, either depict the documented manifestation as an active, overwhelming force (the sky itself splitting, a storm swallowing the steppe) with the choice recorded in artistic_choices, or decline the entry with status tidak-digambar. A calm scene without agency fails.
user_policy.self_check: Before accepting an image the generator answers all of these with yes: the being dominates the frame; it still looks dangerous or majestic at 200 px; there is a moment, not a static pose; each visible effect points to a claim id; head, eye and limb counts match the claims; no text, watermark, border or borrowed design; it would not be rejected as ordinary person, ordinary animal, landscape only, or cute and calm. One no means regenerate, keep the rejected attempt as history, up to three attempts.
user_policy.style: Square premium painterly cinematic illustration in the house style of the existing artwork, more dramatic and higher contrast. No text, labels, logo, border or watermark.
user_policy.sources: Never copy designs from films, games, anime or comics (modern_depictions). Every design is original and sourced from the accepted research.

omitted.reason: Accepted research gives hand/foot healing worship, offerings, shrines, round sacred stone Okagami-ishi and historical warrior-origin spirit, but no deity bodily form or documented active manifestation. A static stone/shrine is landscape/object-only and fails Sangar; warrior-origin does not document Ashite Kōjin appearing as a samurai. No imported Shōmen Kongō anatomy or invented miraculous energy.

Tiga percobaan kualitas gagal jumlah satu kepala sepuluh tubuh: attempt01 8–9 ekor, attempt02 delapan, attempt03 hanya sembilan terpisah (5kiri4kanan). Semua PNG nyata dan request/hash/alasan diarsipkan; tidak memilih gambar anatomi salah.

Accepted research hanya memberi susunan kelompok, nama/sifat/dekorasi, wujud turtle untukBixi dan tiger untukBian; tidak menyediakan wujud konkret seluruh sembilan anggota dan nama berbeda menurut daftar. Tidak mengarang tujuh wujud tambahan atau sembilan naga generik. Tidak ada generasi dicoba.
